Script.name: GaldamUI
Script.script:
GaldamUI = GaldamUI or {} if GaldamUI._handlers then for _, id in ipairs(GaldamUI._handlers) do pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, id) end end GaldamUI._handlers = {} GaldamUI.VERSION = "v64" -- 한국 해안 월드 · 전술 타일 개편 local PANEL_W = 0.20 -- 우측 탭 패널 폭 local BOTTOM_H = 120 -- 하단 HUD 바 높이 GaldamUI.BOTTOM_H = BOTTOM_H -- 커스텀 이미지 GaldamUI.imgDir = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/galdamui" pcall(function() lfs.mkdir(GaldamUI.imgDir) end) local IMGBASE = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Binkaze/galdamoosound@main/" local IMGFILES = {"up-arrow.png","down arrow.png","left-arrow.png","right-arrow.png","up.png","down.png","in.png","out.png","look.png","search.png", "status_cold.png","status_heat.png","status_wet.png","status_drunk.png","status_caffeine.png","status_smoke.png","status_nausea.png", "status_bleeding.png","status_stunned.png","status_broken.png","status_hunger.png","status_thirst.png","status_fatigue.png","status_heavy.png", "man_stat.png","woman_stat.png"} local STANCE_IMGFILES = {"stance_stand_v2.png","stance_sit_v2.png","stance_prone_v2.png","stance_walk_v2.png","stance_fastwalk_v2.png","stance_run_v2.png"} for _, f in ipairs(STANCE_IMGFILES) do IMGFILES[#IMGFILES + 1] = f end local STANCE_DISABLED_IMGFILES = {"stance_walk_v2_disabled.png","stance_fastwalk_v2_disabled.png","stance_run_v2_disabled.png"} for _, f in ipairs(STANCE_DISABLED_IMGFILES) do IMGFILES[#IMGFILES + 1] = f end for i = 0, 20 do IMGFILES[#IMGFILES + 1] = string.format("stance_cd_%02d.png", i) end local function imgPath(f) return GaldamUI.imgDir .. "/" .. f end local function imgTag(f, sz) return "
" end GaldamUI.imgTag = imgTag; GaldamUI.imgPath = imgPath local CSS_BTN = "background-color: rgba(34,84,116,205); border:2px solid #4fa3c7; border-radius:8px; qproperty-alignment:'AlignCenter';" local CSS_ACT = "background-color: rgba(38,70,48,215); border:2px solid #5fae6f; border-radius:8px; qproperty-alignment:'AlignCenter';" local CSS_OFF = "background: qlineargradient(x1:0, y1:0, x2:1, y2:1, stop:0.42 rgba(20,13,15,255), stop:0.46 #cc2b2b, stop:0.54 #cc2b2b, stop:0.58 rgba(20,13,15,255)); border:2px solid #7a2e2e; border-radius:6px; color:#9a7478; font-size:18px; qproperty-alignment:'AlignCenter';" -- 상태 아이콘: 한글 이름(툴팁) + severity 색(경고/심함/위험) GaldamUI.STNAME = {cold="추위/저체온", heat="더위", wet="젖음", drunk="취함", caffeine="카페인", smoke="흡연", nausea="메스꺼움", bleeding="출혈", stunned="감전/기절", broken="골절", hunger="배고픔", thirst="목마름", fatigue="피로", heavy="과적재"} GaldamUI.STSEV = {[1]={b="#f1c40f", bg="rgba(60,52,12,210)"}, [2]={b="#e67e22", bg="rgba(72,42,12,215)"}, [3]={b="#e74c3c", bg="rgba(74,20,20,225)"}} -- 스킬/능력치 한글 라벨 GaldamUI.SKNAME = { brawn="완력", brains="지능", cool="침착", reflexes="반사", endurance="지구력", senses="감각", pistols="권총", rifles="소총", quickdraw="속사", dodge="회피", craft="제작", repair="수리", cook="요리", locksmith="자물쇠", climb="등반", appraise="감정", medic="의술", swim="수영", blades="도검", scavenge="수색", hack="해킹", clubs="둔기", fists="격투", pilot="조종", throw="투척", steal="소매치기", track="추적", chemistry="화학", linguist="언어", sneak="은신", fuck="정사", persuade="설득", whip="채찍", spears="창", teach="교육", fish="낚시", bombs="폭탄", torture="고문", wrestle="레슬링", science="과학", flails="철퇴", ride="승마", focus="집중", } -- 즉시 뜨는 커스텀 툴팁 (네이티브는 표시 지연이 길어 hover 핸들러로 대체) function GaldamUI.showTip(txt) if not GaldamUI.tip then return end local x, y = 0, 0 if not pcall(function() x, y = getMousePosition() end) then return end local wpx = math.max(60, math.min(240, #txt * 6 + 24)) pcall(function() GaldamUI.tip:resize(wpx, 26); GaldamUI.tip:move(x + 14, y + 18) end) GaldamUI.tip:echo("
"..txt.."
") GaldamUI.tip:show() pcall(function() raiseWindow("GaldamTip") end) end function GaldamUI.hideTip() pcall(function() GaldamUI.tip:hide() end) end function GaldamUI.attachTip(w, txt) local ok = pcall(function() w:setOnEnter(function() GaldamUI.showTip(txt) end) w:setOnLeave(function() GaldamUI.hideTip() end) end) if not ok then pcall(function() w:setToolTip(""..txt.."") end) end end function GaldamUI.downloadImages() for _, f in ipairs(IMGFILES) do local lp = imgPath(f) if not (io.exists and io.exists(lp)) then downloadFile(lp, IMGBASE .. (f:gsub(" ", "%%20"))) end end end -- ===== 탭 정의 (확장형: 여기에 항목만 추가하면 새 탭 생성) ===== -- key=식별자, name=표시이름, render=콘텐츠 그리기 함수명(문자열로 늦은 바인딩) GaldamUI.TABS = { {key="players", name="접속자", icon=nil, render="renderPlayers"}, {key="skills", name="스킬", icon=nil, render="renderSkills"}, {key="help", name="도움말", icon=nil, render="renderHelp"}, {key="ach", name="도전과제", icon=nil, render="renderAch"}, {key="events", name="이벤트", icon=nil, render="renderEvents"}, {key="body", name="신체", icon=nil, render="renderBody"}, } function GaldamUI.build() -- 기존 정리 (구버전 우측 HUD 요소 포함 — 재로드 시 잔재 제거) for _, k in ipairs({"bottom","rpanel","panel","info","dpad","act","statusBar"}) do if GaldamUI[k] then pcall(function() GaldamUI[k]:hide() end) end end -- ===== 하단 HUD 바 (전체폭, 최하단) ===== GaldamUI.bottom = Geyser.Container:new({name="GaldamBottom", x=0, y=0, width="100%", height=BOTTOM_H}) -- 상태 아이콘 슬롯 (onStatus 에서 px 배치) GaldamUI.statusSlots = {} for i = 1, 14 do local s = Geyser.Label:new({name="stSlot"..i, x=4, y=4, width=46, height=46}, GaldamUI.bottom) s:hide(); GaldamUI.statusSlots[i] = s end -- 게이지 4 (가로, 좌측 78%) GaldamUI.gauges = {} local function gauge(name, label, color, gx, w) local g = Geyser.Gauge:new({name=name, x=gx, y=58, width=(w or "19%"), height=56}, GaldamUI.bottom) g.front:setStyleSheet("background-color:"..color.."; border-radius:5px;") g.back:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(40,40,40,200); border-radius:5px;") g.text:setStyleSheet("color:#ffffff; font-size:13px; padding-left:5px;") g:setValue(100,100,""..label..""); return g end GaldamUI.hp = gauge("GaldamHP", "혈액", "#c0392b", "1%", "12.5%") GaldamUI.cons = gauge("GaldamCon", "의식", "#27ae60", "14%", "12.5%") GaldamUI.thirst = gauge("GaldamThi", "목마름", "#2471a3", "27%", "12.5%") GaldamUI.hunger = gauge("GaldamHun", "배고픔", "#d68910", "40%", "12.5%") GaldamUI.stress = gauge("GaldamStr", "스트레스", "#f1c40f", "53%", "12.5%") GaldamUI.stamina = gauge("GaldamStm", "기력", "#16a085", "66%", "12.5%") GaldamUI.buildStanceControl() -- ===== 우측 탭 패널 ===== GaldamUI.rpanel = Geyser.Container:new({name="GaldamRPanel", x="-"..PANEL_W*100 .."%", y=0, width=PANEL_W*100 .."%", height="100%"}) -- 위치 헤더 GaldamUI.locHeader = Geyser.Label:new({name="GaldamLoc", x=0, y=0, width="100%", height=40}, GaldamUI.rpanel) GaldamUI.locHeader:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(15,25,35,235); border:1px solid #2a4a5a; border-radius:6px; color:#cfe8f0; qproperty-alignment:'AlignCenter';") GaldamUI.locHeader:echo("
갯담마을
") -- 버전 스탬프 (우상단, 업데이트 적용 확인용) GaldamUI.verTag = Geyser.Label:new({name="GaldamVer", x="74%", y=2, width="25%", height=14}, GaldamUI.rpanel) GaldamUI.verTag:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(0,0,0,0); color:#587584; qproperty-alignment:'AlignRight';") GaldamUI.verTag:echo(""..(GaldamUI.VERSION or "?").."") -- 실시간 방 패널 (사람/물건 — hover=명령전체, 클릭=드롭다운 메뉴). 라벨 호스트. 위치는 relayout GaldamUI.roomBox = Geyser.Container:new({name="GaldamRoomBox", x=0, y=44, width="100%", height=200}, GaldamUI.rpanel) GaldamUI.roomRows = GaldamUI.roomRows or {} -- 탭 버튼 행 GaldamUI.tabBtns = {} local n = #GaldamUI.TABS for i, t in ipairs(GaldamUI.TABS) do local bw = math.floor(100 / n) local b = Geyser.Label:new({name="tab_"..t.key, x=((i-1)*bw) .."%", y=44, width=(bw-1) .."%", height=38}, GaldamUI.rpanel) b:setClickCallback(function() GaldamUI.selectTab(t.key) end) GaldamUI.attachTip(b, t.name) GaldamUI.tabBtns[t.key] = b end -- 콘텐츠 (스크롤 가능) GaldamUI.content = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({name="GaldamTabContent", x=0, y=88, width="100%", height=200}, GaldamUI.rpanel) GaldamUI.content:setColor(14, 18, 26) pcall(function() GaldamUI.content:setFontSize(11) end) GaldamUI.content:setWrap(28) -- 신체 상태 뷰 (신체 탭 전용 — 확장 모드에서 방 패널 자리까지 사용) GaldamUI.bodyBox = Geyser.Container:new({name="GaldamBodyBox", x=0, y=88, width="100%", height=200}, GaldamUI.rpanel) GaldamUI.bodyImg = Geyser.Label:new({name="GaldamBodyImg", x=0, y=0, width=10, height=10}, GaldamUI.bodyBox) GaldamUI.bodyRows = {} GaldamUI.bodyCtx = {box=GaldamUI.bodyBox, img=GaldamUI.bodyImg, rows=GaldamUI.bodyRows, pre="gb"} GaldamUI.bodyBox:hide() -- ===== NPC 신체 관찰 팝업 (보기/감정/진찰 시 Galdam.BodyNPC 수신 → 표시) ===== pcall(function() if not GaldamUI.npcWin then GaldamUI.npcWin = Geyser.UserWindow:new({name="갯담관찰", width=430, height=700, x=460, y=90}) end GaldamUI.npcHdr = Geyser.Label:new({name="GnpcHdr", x=0, y=0, width="100%", height=30}, GaldamUI.npcWin) GaldamUI.npcHdr:setStyleSheet("background-color:#161b13; border-bottom:1px solid #55554d; qproperty-alignment:'AlignCenter';") GaldamUI.npcBox = Geyser.Container:new({name="GnpcBox", x=0, y=30, width="100%", height="100%-30px"}, GaldamUI.npcWin) GaldamUI.npcImg = Geyser.Label:new({name="GnpcImg", x=0, y=0, width=10, height=10}, GaldamUI.npcBox) GaldamUI.npcCtx = {box=GaldamUI.npcBox, img=GaldamUI.npcImg, rows={}, pre="gnb"} GaldamUI.npcData = nil GaldamUI.npcWin:hide() end) -- ===== d-pad 미니창: 폐기 (키보드 이동모드로 대체, 2026-06-12) — 배 전용 조종패드는 GaldamBoatPad 블록 ===== pcall(function() if GaldamUI.dpadWin then GaldamUI.dpadWin:hide() end end) GaldamUI.dirBtns = nil -- 수배 오버레이 (좌상단) if GaldamUI.wanted then GaldamUI.wanted:hide() end GaldamUI.wanted = Geyser.Label:new({name="GaldamWan", x="-43%", y=4, width="20%", height=66}) GaldamUI.wanted:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(22,14,28,235); border:1px solid #5a3a6a; border-radius:6px; qproperty-alignment:'AlignCenter';") GaldamUI.wanted:hide() GaldamUI.cycleGen = (GaldamUI.cycleGen or 0) + 1 GaldamUI.cyclePhase = 0 GaldamUI.cycleStep(GaldamUI.cycleGen) -- Smartphone atlas replaces the paid paper-map window. if GaldamUI.mapWin then pcall(function() GaldamUI.mapWin:hide() end) end -- 커스텀 툴팁 라벨 (최상위, 마지막 생성 → z순서 위) pcall(function() if GaldamUI.tip then GaldamUI.tip:hide() end GaldamUI.tip = Geyser.Label:new({name="GaldamTip", x=0, y=0, width=140, height=26}) GaldamUI.tip:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(16,20,28,245); border:1px solid #6fbf80; border-radius:5px; color:#eafff0;") GaldamUI.tip:hide() end) GaldamUI.built = true GaldamUI.activeTab = GaldamUI.activeTab or "players" GaldamUI.relayout() GaldamUI.selectTab(GaldamUI.activeTab) end function GaldamUI.relayout() if not GaldamUI.built then return end local w, h = getMainWindowSize() local rw = math.floor(w * PANEL_W) setBorderRight(rw); setBorderBottom(BOTTOM_H) pcall(function() GaldamUI.bottom:move(0, h - BOTTOM_H); GaldamUI.bottom:resize(w, BOTTOM_H) if GaldamKeys and GaldamKeys.placeIndicator then GaldamKeys.placeIndicator() end local ph = h - BOTTOM_H GaldamUI.rpanel:move(w - rw, 0); GaldamUI.rpanel:resize(rw, ph) -- 상하분할: [헤더] / [방 패널] / [탭 버튼] / [탭 콘텐츠] local headH, tabH, gap = 40, 32, 4 local avail = ph - headH - tabH - gap * 4 if avail < 80 then avail = 80 end local roomH = math.floor(avail * 0.52) -- 상단: 실시간 방 패널 local contentH = avail - roomH -- 하단: 탭 콘텐츠 GaldamUI.locHeader:move(0, 0); GaldamUI.locHeader:resize(rw, headH) local roomY = headH + gap -- 신체 탭 = 확장 모드: 방 패널을 숨기고 탭열을 위로, 신체 뷰가 나머지 전체 사용 local bodyMode = (GaldamUI.activeTab == "body") local tabY if bodyMode then tabY = roomY pcall(function() GaldamUI.roomBox:hide() end) else GaldamUI.roomBox:move(0, roomY); GaldamUI.roomBox:resize(rw, roomH) pcall(function() GaldamUI.roomBox:show() end) tabY = roomY + roomH + gap end local n = #GaldamUI.TABS local bw = math.floor(rw / n) for i, t in ipairs(GaldamUI.TABS) do local b = GaldamUI.tabBtns[t.key] if b then b:move((i - 1) * bw, tabY); b:resize(bw - 2, tabH) end end local cY = tabY + tabH + gap if bodyMode then pcall(function() GaldamUI.content:hide() end) if GaldamUI.bodyBox then GaldamUI.bodyBox:move(0, cY); GaldamUI.bodyBox:resize(rw, ph - cY - gap) GaldamUI.bodyBox:show() pcall(GaldamUI.renderBody) end else if GaldamUI.bodyBox then pcall(function() GaldamUI.bodyBox:hide() end) end GaldamUI.content:move(0, cY); GaldamUI.content:resize(rw, contentH) pcall(function() GaldamUI.content:show() end) end end) GaldamUI.renderRoom() end function GaldamUI.setExits(elist) if not GaldamUI.dirBtns then return end local avail = {} for _, e in ipairs(elist or {}) do avail[tostring(e)] = true end for _, d in ipairs(GaldamUI.dirBtns) do local on = false for _, al in ipairs(d.aliases) do if avail[al] then on = true; break end end if on then d.btn:setStyleSheet(CSS_BTN); d.btn:echo(imgTag(d.img, 34)) GaldamUI.attachTip(d.btn, d.name) else d.btn:setStyleSheet(CSS_OFF) d.btn:echo("
"..d.name.."
") GaldamUI.attachTip(d.btn, d.name.." · 막힌 길") end end end -- ===== 탭 전환 / 렌더 ===== function GaldamUI.selectTab(key) if not GaldamUI.built then return end local prev = GaldamUI.activeTab GaldamUI.activeTab = key pcall(GaldamUI.relayout) if prev == "body" and key ~= "body" then pcall(GaldamUI.renderRoom) end for _, t in ipairs(GaldamUI.TABS) do local b = GaldamUI.tabBtns[t.key] if b then if t.key == key then b:setStyleSheet(CSS_ACT) else b:setStyleSheet(CSS_BTN) end if t.icon then b:echo(imgTag(t.icon, 28)) else b:echo("
"..t.name.."
") end end end GaldamUI.renderTab() end function GaldamUI.renderTab() if not (GaldamUI.built and GaldamUI.content) then return end for _, t in ipairs(GaldamUI.TABS) do if t.key == GaldamUI.activeTab then local fn = GaldamUI[t.render] if fn then pcall(fn) else GaldamUI.content:clear(); GaldamUI.content:cecho("\n (미구현)") end return end end end function GaldamUI.renderPlayers() GaldamUI.content:clear() GaldamUI.content:cecho("\n ● 접속 중\n\n") local d = gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.Players local cnt = 0 if d and d.list and d.list ~= "" then for entry in tostring(d.list):gmatch("[^;]+") do local nm, ar = entry:match("([^|]*)|(.*)") GaldamUI.content:cecho(" "..(nm or entry).." "..(ar or "").."\n") cnt = cnt + 1 end end if cnt == 0 then GaldamUI.content:cecho(" (목록 없음)\n") end end function GaldamUI.renderSkills() GaldamUI.content:clear() local d = gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.Skills local stats, skills = {}, {} if d and d.list and d.list ~= "" then for entry in tostring(d.list):gmatch("[^;]+") do local nm, v, k = entry:match("([^|]*)|([^|]*)|([^|]*)") if nm then local kor = GaldamUI.SKNAME[nm] or nm if k == "S" then stats[#stats+1] = {kor, v} else skills[#skills+1] = {kor, v} end end end end GaldamUI.content:cecho("\n ● 능력치\n\n") if #stats > 0 then for _, e in ipairs(stats) do GaldamUI.content:cecho(" "..e[1].." "..e[2].."\n") end else GaldamUI.content:cecho(" (정보 없음)\n") end GaldamUI.content:cecho("\n ● 스킬\n\n") if #skills > 0 then for _, e in ipairs(skills) do GaldamUI.content:cecho(" "..e[1].." "..e[2].."\n") end else GaldamUI.content:cecho(" (배운 스킬 없음)\n") end end -- 도움말 데이터 (카테고리 클릭 → 명령어/설명). 변수부는 [..]로 표기 (cecho가 <>를 색태그로 먹음) GaldamUI.HELP = { {"이동", {"동 · 서 · 남 · 북", "올라가기 · 내려가기", "들어가기 · 나가기", "왼쪽 방향키 창으로도 됩니다."}}, {"살펴보기", {"보기 [대상]", "살펴보기 [대상]", "패널 항목 클릭으로도 됩니다."}}, {"먹기·마시기", {"먹기 [음식]", "마시기 [음료]"}}, {"줍기·버리기", {"줍기 [물건] (=집기)", "버리기 [물건] (=놓기)"}}, {"장착·사용", {"장착 [무기/옷]", "사용 [물건]", "읽기 [글]"}}, {"용기·상자", {"개봉 / 덮기 [용기]", "엿보기 [용기]", "[용기]에서 [물건] 꺼내기", "[용기]에 [물건] 넣기"}}, {"복합 명령", {"조사로 자연스럽게 (동사는 맨 뒤):", "자판기에서 콜라 꺼내기", "상자에 동전 넣기", "영희에게 사과 주기", "상인에게 5000 지불", "~에서=출처 ~에게=상대 ~에=위치"}}, {"장소 명령어", {"이 방에서만 쓰는 명령.", "패널 ● 장소 명령어 또는 ex here", "예) 바다: 첨벙·담그기·들이켜기"}}, {"전투", {"공격 [상대]", "항복"}}, {"패널 사용법", {"오른쪽 패널:", "· 항목 클릭 → 상호작용 메뉴", "· ✨ = 방금 나타난 것", "· 초록=바로실행 / 회색=추가입력"}}, } function GaldamUI.helpPick(cat) GaldamUI.helpCat = (cat and cat ~= "") and cat or nil GaldamUI.renderTab() end function GaldamUI.renderHelp() local mn = "GaldamTabContent" GaldamUI.content:clear() if not GaldamUI.helpCat then GaldamUI.content:cecho("\n ● 도움말 (눌러 보기)\n\n") for _, h in ipairs(GaldamUI.HELP) do GaldamUI.content:cecho(" ▸ ") pcall(function() echoLink(mn, h[1], "GaldamUI.helpPick([[" .. h[1] .. "]])", h[1], true) end) GaldamUI.content:echo("\n") end else GaldamUI.content:cecho("\n ● " .. GaldamUI.helpCat .. "\n\n") for _, h in ipairs(GaldamUI.HELP) do if h[1] == GaldamUI.helpCat then for _, ln in ipairs(h[2]) do GaldamUI.content:cecho(" " .. ln .. "\n") end break end end GaldamUI.content:cecho("\n ") pcall(function() echoLink(mn, "← 목록으로", "GaldamUI.helpPick()", "뒤로", true) end) GaldamUI.content:echo("\n") end end function GaldamUI.renderEvents() GaldamUI.content:clear() GaldamUI.content:cecho("\n ● 진행 중 이벤트\n\n 🚧 준비 중\n 이벤트 시스템이 구축되면\n 여기에 표시됩니다.\n") end -- 도전과제 탭 (접이식 트리): list = "id|이름|설명|달성0/1|최초자|달성수|카테고리;..." ") GaldamUI.attachTip(ctx.orgTxt, "폐 천공·복강 내출혈은 봉합으로 치료 / 심장 관통=즉사") ctx.orgFrame:show(); ctx.orgTxt:show() end function GaldamUI.renderBody() if not (GaldamUI.built and GaldamUI.bodyCtx) then return end GaldamUI.renderBodyInto(GaldamUI.bodyCtx, gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.Body) end -- NPC 신체 팝업: 보기/감정/진찰 시 서버가 Galdam.BodyNPC 푸시 → 플로팅창 표시 function GaldamUI.onBodyNPC(rerender) if not (GaldamUI.built and GaldamUI.npcWin and GaldamUI.npcCtx) then return end local d = rerender and GaldamUI.npcData or (gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.BodyNPC) if not d then return end GaldamUI.npcData = d local nm = tostring(d.name or "?") -- 같은 대상의 실시간 재푸시는 강제 표시 없이 내용만 갱신 (닫은 창 다시 안 띄움) local isNew = (GaldamUI.npcLast ~= nm) GaldamUI.npcLast = nm if isNew or rerender then pcall(function() GaldamUI.npcWin:show() end) end GaldamUI.npcHdr:echo("
" .. nm .. " — 신체 상태
") GaldamUI.renderBodyInto(GaldamUI.npcCtx, d) end function GaldamUI.refresh() if not GaldamUI.built then return end pcall(function() GaldamUI.lookBtn:setStyleSheet(CSS_ACT); GaldamUI.lookBtn:echo(imgTag("look.png", 34)) end) GaldamUI.onRoom(); GaldamUI.onVitals(); GaldamUI.onStatus(); GaldamUI.renderTab() end if not GaldamUI.built then GaldamUI.build() end GaldamUI.relayout() GaldamUI.downloadImages() table.insert(GaldamUI._handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Room", function() GaldamUI.onRoom() end)) table.insert(GaldamUI._handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.ObjMenu", function() GaldamUI.onObjMenu() end)) table.insert(GaldamUI._handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Vitals", function() GaldamUI.onVitals() end)) table.insert(GaldamUI._handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Status", function() GaldamUI.onStatus() end)) table.insert(GaldamUI._handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Map", function() GaldamUI.onMap() end)) table.insert(GaldamUI._handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Players", function() if GaldamUI.activeTab=="players" then GaldamUI.renderTab() end end)) table.insert(GaldamUI._handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Skills", function() if GaldamUI.activeTab=="skills" then GaldamUI.renderTab() end end)) table.insert(GaldamUI._handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Achievements", function() if GaldamUI.activeTab=="ach" then GaldamUI.renderTab() end end)) table.insert(GaldamUI._handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Body", function() if GaldamUI.activeTab=="body" then GaldamUI.renderBody() end end)) table.insert(GaldamUI._handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.BodyNPC", function() GaldamUI.onBodyNPC() end)) table.insert(GaldamUI._handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysUserWindowResizeEvent", function(_, w, h, win) if win == "갯담관찰" and GaldamUI.npcData then GaldamUI.onBodyNPC(true) end end)) table.insert(GaldamUI._handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysWindowResizeEvent", function() GaldamUI.relayout() end)) table.insert(GaldamUI._handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", function() GaldamUI.refresh() end)) GaldamUI.onRoom(); GaldamUI.onVitals(); GaldamUI.onStatus(); GaldamUI.onMap()

Script.name: GaldamLockpickQTE
Script.script:
-- ===== Galdam 자물쇠 따기 QTE (v2 클릭) ===== GaldamPick = GaldamPick or {} local GP = GaldamPick GP.W = 46 function GaldamPick_hit() -- 전역 (클릭/키 콜백용) GaldamPick.hit() end function GP.makeWindow() if not GP.win then GP.win = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "GaldamPickWin", x = "30%", y = "33%", width = "40%", height = "28%", }) GP.win:setStyleSheet([[ background-color: rgba(18,18,24,238); border: 2px solid #c8a05a; border-radius: 10px; ]]) GP.win:setFontSize(13) GP.win:hide() end GP.win:setClickCallback("GaldamPick_hit") -- 창 클릭 = 입력 (재로드시에도 재적용) end function GP.render() local cells = {} local needle = math.floor((GP.pos or 0) / 100 * GP.W + 0.5) local zs = math.floor((GP.zstart or 0) / 100 * GP.W + 0.5) local ze = math.floor(((GP.zstart or 0) + (GP.zsize or 0)) / 100 * GP.W + 0.5) local cz = math.floor(((GP.zstart or 0) + (GP.zsize or 0) / 2) / 100 * GP.W + 0.5) for i = 0, GP.W do if i == needle then cells[#cells+1] = "|" elseif i == cz then cells[#cells+1] = "@" elseif i >= zs and i <= ze then cells[#cells+1] = "#" else cells[#cells+1] = "-" end end local html = string.format( "

[ 자물쇠 따기 ]

%s

진행 %d / %d    라운드 %d

바늘이 초록(@중앙)일 때  창을 클릭!
", table.concat(cells), GP.prog or 0, GP.target or 5, GP.round or 1) GP.win:echo(html) end function GP.tick() if not GP.active then return end GP.pos = GP.pos + GP.dir * GP.step if GP.pos >= 100 then GP.pos = 100; GP.dir = -1 end if GP.pos <= 0 then GP.pos = 0; GP.dir = 1 end GP.render() GP.timer = tempTimer(0.045, GP.tick) end function GP.onRound() local d = gmcp.Galdam.Pick.Round if not d then return end GP.makeWindow() GP.zstart = tonumber(d.zone_start) or 40 GP.zsize = tonumber(d.zone_size) or 20 GP.prog = tonumber(d.progress) or 0 GP.target = tonumber(d.target) or 5 GP.round = tonumber(d.round) or 1 GP.step = math.max(1.8, (tonumber(d.speed) or 50) / 12) GP.pos = 0; GP.dir = 1; GP.active = true if GP.timer then killTimer(GP.timer) end GP.win:show() pcall(function() raiseWindow("GaldamPickWin") end) -- 격자맵보다 앞으로 (가려짐 방지) GP.tick() end function GP.hit() if not GP.active then return end GP.active = false if GP.timer then killTimer(GP.timer); GP.timer = nil end send("qtehit " .. tostring(math.floor((GP.pos or 0) + 0.5))) end function GP.onEnd() GP.active = false if GP.timer then killTimer(GP.timer); GP.timer = nil end if GP.win then GP.win:hide() end end function GP.onConnect() send("qte_on") end if GP.h1 then killAnonymousEventHandler(GP.h1) end if GP.h2 then killAnonymousEventHandler(GP.h2) end if GP.h3 then killAnonymousEventHandler(GP.h3) end GP.h1 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Pick.Round", "GaldamPick.onRound") GP.h2 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Pick.End", "GaldamPick.onEnd") GP.h3 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", "GaldamPick.onConnect") GP.makeWindow() if gmcp then GP.onConnect() end echo("[Galdam] 자물쇠 따기 QTE v2 로드됨. `따기 <방향>` 시작, 창 클릭으로 입력.\n")

Script.name: GaldamFishingQTE
Script.script:
-- ===== Galdam 낚시 QTE v6 ===== GaldamFish = GaldamFish or {} local GF = GaldamFish GF.W = 48 GF.biteSound = GF.biteSound or nil -- 입질 효과음 파일/URL 지정 시 재생 function GaldamFish_hit() GaldamFish.hit() end function GaldamFish_press() GaldamFish.press() end function GaldamFish_release() GaldamFish.release() end function GaldamFish_closecard() GaldamFish.closeCard() end function GF.makeWindow() if not GF.win then GF.win = Geyser.Label:new({name = "GaldamFishWin", x = "26%", y = "28%", width = "48%", height = "24%"}) GF.win:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(10,22,34,243); border: 2px solid #3a8fb7; border-radius: 10px;") GF.win:setFontSize(13) GF.win:hide() end end function GF.playBiteSound() if GF.biteSound then pcall(function() playSoundFile({name = "galdamBite", file = GF.biteSound}) end) end end -- ========== 입질 연출 (2초 뜸 + 사운드) ========== function GF.onBite() GF.makeWindow() GF.mode = "bite" GF.win:resize("48%", "24%"); GF.win:move("26%", "28%") GF.win:setClickCallback(""); GF.win:setReleaseCallback("") if GF.timer then killTimer(GF.timer) end GF.biteAnim = 0 GF.playBiteSound() GF.win:show() GF.biteTick() end function GF.biteTick() if GF.mode ~= "bite" then return end GF.biteAnim = GF.biteAnim + 1 local big = (GF.biteAnim % 2 == 0) local color = big and "#ff3030" or "#ffcf33" local sz = big and "23px" or "19px" GF.win:echo("


❗ 입질! ❗

찌가 까딱까딱... 곧 챔질 타이밍!
") GF.timer = tempTimer(0.22, GF.biteTick) end -- ========== 챔질 (클릭 타이밍) ========== function GF.renderHook() local cells = {} local needle = math.floor((GF.pos or 0) / 100 * GF.W + 0.5) local zs = math.floor((GF.zstart or 0) / 100 * GF.W + 0.5) local ze = math.floor(((GF.zstart or 0) + (GF.zsize or 0)) / 100 * GF.W + 0.5) local cz = math.floor(((GF.zstart or 0) + (GF.zsize or 0) / 2) / 100 * GF.W + 0.5) for i = 0, GF.W do if i == needle then cells[#cells+1] = "|" elseif i == cz then cells[#cells+1] = "🐟" elseif i >= zs and i <= ze then cells[#cells+1] = "#" else cells[#cells+1] = "~" end end GF.win:echo(string.format( "

[ 🎣 챔질! 찌가 쑥 들어간다 ]

%s

찌(|)가 🐟(초록칸)에 왔을 때  창 클릭!
", table.concat(cells))) end function GF.tickHook() if not GF.active or GF.mode ~= "hook" then return end GF.pos = GF.pos + GF.dir * GF.step if GF.pos >= 100 then GF.pos = 100; GF.dir = -1 end if GF.pos <= 0 then GF.pos = 0; GF.dir = 1 end GF.renderHook() GF.timer = tempTimer(0.045, GF.tickHook) end function GF.onHook(d) d = d or (gmcp and gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.Fish and gmcp.Galdam.Fish.Hook) if not d then return end GF.makeWindow() GF.mode = "hook" GF.win:resize("48%", "24%"); GF.win:move("26%", "28%") GF.zstart = tonumber(d.zone_start) or 40 GF.zsize = tonumber(d.zone_size) or 20 GF.step = math.max(1.8, (tonumber(d.speed) or 50) / 12) GF.pos = 0; GF.dir = 1; GF.active = true GF.win:setClickCallback("GaldamFish_hit") GF.win:setReleaseCallback("") if GF.timer then killTimer(GF.timer) end GF.win:show() GF.tickHook() end function GF.hit() if not GF.active or GF.mode ~= "hook" then return end GF.active = false if GF.timer then killTimer(GF.timer); GF.timer = nil end if GF.previewMode then GF.onFight({boxsize = 22, diff = 26}); return end send("qtefish " .. tostring(math.floor((GF.pos or 0) + 0.5))) end -- ========== 힘겨루기 (스타듀 세로막대) ========== function GF.onFight(d) d = d or (gmcp and gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.Fish and (gmcp.Galdam.Fish.Fight or gmcp.Galdam.Fish.Reel)) if not d then return end GF.makeWindow() GF.mode = "fight" GF.win:resize("17%", "54%"); GF.win:move("42%", "20%") GF.barHeight = tonumber(d.boxsize) or 22 GF.diff = tonumber(d.diff) or 24 GF.fishPos = 50; GF.fishTarget = 50; GF.fishMoveTimer = 10 GF.barPos = 38; GF.barVel = 0; GF.catch = 26; GF.held = false; GF.active = true GF.win:setClickCallback("GaldamFish_press") GF.win:setReleaseCallback("GaldamFish_release") if GF.timer then killTimer(GF.timer) end GF.win:show() GF.fightTick() end function GF.press() GF.held = true end function GF.release() GF.held = false end function GF.fightTick() if not GF.active or GF.mode ~= "fight" then return end GF.fishMoveTimer = GF.fishMoveTimer - 1 if GF.fishMoveTimer <= 0 then GF.fishTarget = math.random(3, 97) GF.fishMoveTimer = math.random(8, 30) if math.random(100) <= (GF.diff * 0.7) then GF.fishMoveTimer = math.random(3, 9) end end local fs = 1.1 + GF.diff / 36 if GF.fishPos < GF.fishTarget then GF.fishPos = math.min(GF.fishTarget, GF.fishPos + fs) elseif GF.fishPos > GF.fishTarget then GF.fishPos = math.max(GF.fishTarget, GF.fishPos - fs) end if GF.held then GF.barVel = GF.barVel + 0.52 else GF.barVel = GF.barVel - 0.44 end GF.barVel = GF.barVel * 0.90 GF.barPos = GF.barPos + GF.barVel if GF.barPos < 0 then GF.barPos = 0; GF.barVel = GF.barVel * -0.25 end if GF.barPos + GF.barHeight > 100 then GF.barPos = 100 - GF.barHeight; GF.barVel = GF.barVel * -0.25 end if GF.fishPos >= GF.barPos and GF.fishPos <= (GF.barPos + GF.barHeight) then GF.catch = math.min(100, GF.catch + 1.1) else GF.catch = math.max(0, GF.catch - 1.0) end if GF.catch >= 100 then return GF.endFight("land") end if GF.catch <= 0 then return GF.endFight("escape") end GF.renderFight() GF.timer = tempTimer(0.06, GF.fightTick) end function GF.renderFight() local R = 17 local lines = {} local fishR = R - 1 - math.floor((GF.fishPos) / 100 * (R - 1) + 0.5) local boxBot = R - 1 - math.floor((GF.barPos) / 100 * (R - 1) + 0.5) local boxTop = R - 1 - math.floor((GF.barPos + GF.barHeight) / 100 * (R - 1) + 0.5) local catchFill = math.floor((GF.catch) / 100 * R + 0.5) for r = 0, R - 1 do local cm = ((R - r) <= catchFill) and "█" or "█" local inbox = (r >= boxTop and r <= boxBot) local seg if r == fishR then seg = inbox and "🐟" or "🐟" elseif inbox then seg = "█" else seg = "│" end lines[#lines+1] = cm .. "  " .. seg end GF.win:echo("
🎣 " .. math.floor(GF.catch) .. "%
" .. table.concat(lines, "
") .. "
누름↑ 놓음↓
█에 🐟 가두기
") end function GF.endFight(outcome) GF.active = false if GF.timer then killTimer(GF.timer); GF.timer = nil end if GF.win then GF.win:hide() end if GF.previewMode then GF.previewMode = false cecho("\n[낚시 프리뷰] 결과: " .. outcome .. "\n") if outcome == "land" then GF.onCaught({name = "망둥어", image = ""}) end return end send("qtefish_result " .. outcome) end function GF.onEnd() GF.active = false; GF.mode = nil; GF.previewMode = false if GF.timer then killTimer(GF.timer); GF.timer = nil end if GF.win then GF.win:hide() end end -- ========== 포획 카드 (어종 이미지 / 5초 / 클릭 닫기) ========== function GF.makeCard() if not GF.cardWin then GF.cardWin = Geyser.Label:new({name = "GaldamFishCard", x = "34%", y = "20%", width = "32%", height = "52%"}) GF.cardWin:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(8,18,28,250); border: 3px solid #d8b15a; border-radius: 12px;") GF.cardWin:setClickCallback("GaldamFish_closecard") GF.cardWin:hide() end end function GF.renderCard(imgOk) local nm = GF.cardName or "물고기" local body if imgOk then body = "









" else body = "


🐟

" end GF.cardWin:echo("
🎣 낚았다!" .. body .. "" .. nm .. "

" .. "창을 클릭하면 닫힘 (5초 후 자동)
") end function GF.onCaught(d) d = d or (gmcp and gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.Fish and gmcp.Galdam.Fish.Caught) if not d then return end GF.makeCard() GF.cardName = d.name or "물고기" GF.cardWin:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(8,18,28,250); border: 3px solid #d8b15a; border-radius: 12px;") local img = d.image or "" if img ~= "" then local base = img:match("([^/]+)$") or "fish.png" local fn = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/galdamfish_" .. base if io.exists(fn) then GF.cardWin:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(8,18,28,250); border: 3px solid #d8b15a; border-radius: 12px; background-image: url(" .. fn .. "); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: center;") GF.renderCard(true) else GF.pendingImg = {url = img, file = fn} pcall(function() downloadFile(fn, img) end) GF.renderCard(false) end else GF.renderCard(false) end GF.cardWin:show() if GF.cardTimer then killTimer(GF.cardTimer) end GF.cardTimer = tempTimer(5.0, function() GF.closeCard() end) end function GF.closeCard() if GF.cardTimer then killTimer(GF.cardTimer); GF.cardTimer = nil end if GF.cardWin then GF.cardWin:hide() end end function GF.onDownload(_, path) if GF.pendingImg and path == GF.pendingImg.file then if GF.cardWin and GF.cardWin.shown ~= false then GF.cardWin:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(8,18,28,250); border: 3px solid #d8b15a; border-radius: 12px; background-image: url(" .. path .. "); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: center;") GF.renderCard(true) end GF.pendingImg = nil end end -- ========== 프리뷰 ========== function GF.preview() GF.previewMode = true GF.onBite() tempTimer(2.0, function() if GF.previewMode then GF.onHook({zone_start = 40, zone_size = 20, speed = 52}) end end) cecho("\n[낚시 프리뷰] 입질 연출 → 챔질(창 클릭) → 힘겨루기 → 포획카드 순으로 시연합니다.\n") end function GF.onPreview() GF.preview() end for _, h in ipairs({"h1","h2","h3","h4","h5","h6","h7"}) do if GF[h] then killAnonymousEventHandler(GF[h]) end end GF.h1 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Fish.Hook", "GaldamFish.onHook") GF.h2 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Fish.Fight", "GaldamFish.onFight") GF.h3 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Fish.End", "GaldamFish.onEnd") GF.h4 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Fish.Reel", "GaldamFish.onFight") GF.h5 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Fish.Bite", "GaldamFish.onBite") GF.h6 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Fish.Preview", "GaldamFish.onPreview") GF.h7 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Fish.Caught", "GaldamFish.onCaught") if GF.hdl then killAnonymousEventHandler(GF.hdl) end GF.hdl = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", "GaldamFish.onDownload") GF.makeWindow() echo("[Galdam] 낚시 QTE v6 로드됨. 입질연출→챔질→힘겨루기(🐟)→포획카드. 미리보기: 낚시프리뷰\n")

Script.name: GaldamTacticalGrid
GaldamTileView
Script.script:
-- ===== Galdam 타일뷰 v1: 글리프 격자의 그래픽 타일 렌더러 (토글 병행, 별도 독립 블록) ===== -- 레이어(z순): ground(타일) < decal(핏자국등) < shade(벽그림자) < obj < item < fx < actor < susdot -- < cone(시야원뿔 rgba) < tint(시간대/날씨 단일) < wx(비/눈 프레임) < glow(빛무리 radial) < fogp(시야음영/실내어둠) -- 조명/이펙트 원리: ①rgba 오버레이 라벨(틴트/원뿔/안개) ②qradialgradient(가로등/경광등/불빛무리) ③PNG 프레임 교체(비/눈/불) GaldamTileView = GaldamTileView or {} local GTV = GaldamTileView if GTV.on == nil then GTV.on = true end -- 기본 = 타일뷰 (글리프는 '타일뷰' 토글로) GTV.P = GTV.P or {} GTV.frame = GTV.frame or 0 GTV.TILEVER = 15 GTV.zdirty = true -- 로드 직후 z순서 1회 재구축 (레이어 순서 변경 반영) GTV.size = GTV.size or 32 -- 현재 셀 크기 (s16/s20/s24/s28/s32 사전생성 타일 = 무스케일링, 블러 방지) GTV.haveSize = {} -- 세션마다 리셋 → 매 접속 1회 무결성 재검사 (깨진 파일 복구 기회) local TDIR = getMudletHomeDir() .. "/galdamtiles" pcall(function() lfs.mkdir(TDIR) end) local TBASE = "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Binkaze/galdamoosound@49d97615fd3f48c6b659e864fee77b26887b0448/tiles/"
-- 타일 파일 목록 (tileset_gen.py 출력과 1:1) local TFILES = {"dirt2","rockg","woodfloor","lane","lane_v","crosswalk","field","paddy","weed","water_0","water_1","stairs_up","stairs_down", "wall_stone","house_wall","shed_wall","shop_wall","breakwater","wall_brick","window","window_open","window_broken","door","gate","greenhouse","lighthouse","tetrapod","grave", "tree","rock","lamp","well","jangdok","bench","clothes","pole","mailbox","busstop","dog","boat","net","dryrack","buoy","reef","prop","hull","helm","trapdoor","pot","console","engine", "jangseung","cairn","signboard","woodpile","beehive","wondumak", "act_player","act_npc","act_cop","act_wild","loot","fire_0","fire_1","smoke_gray","smoke_white","smoke_gas", "blood_1","blood_2","blood_3","glass","wetg","snowg","mess"} for i = 0, 3 do for _, b in ipairs({"dirt","grass","asphalt","clearing"}) do TFILES[#TFILES+1] = b.."_"..i end end for i = 0, 15 do TFILES[#TFILES+1] = "fence_"..i end for _, v in ipairs({"car","truck","trac","police"}) do TFILES[#TFILES+1] = v.."_l"; TFILES[#TFILES+1] = v.."_r" end for i = 0, 2 do TFILES[#TFILES+1] = "rain_"..i; TFILES[#TFILES+1] = "snow_"..i end for _, f in ipairs({"wood","hardwood","tile","marble","stone","concrete","carpet","carpet_blue","carpet_green","linoleum","dirt","ondol"}) do TFILES[#TFILES+1] = "floor_"..f end for _, f in ipairs({"bed","table","chair","fridge","sink","gasrange","cupboard","bar","toilet","bathtub","washbasin", "wardrobe","desk","computer","dresser","drawers","safe","sofa","tv","bookshelf","washer","stove", "counter","shelf","medcab","fish_stall","crate","barrel","bollard","cooler","crabpot","crop1","crop2","crop3"}) do TFILES[#TFILES+1] = f end for _, f in ipairs({"n","ne","e","se","s","sw","w","nw"}) do TFILES[#TFILES+1] = "arr_"..f end for _, material in ipairs({"concrete","sand","mudflat","pebbles"}) do for i = 0, 3 do TFILES[#TFILES+1] = material.."_"..i end end for _, material in ipairs({"house_wall","shed_wall","shop_wall","wall_stone"}) do for i = 0, 15 do TFILES[#TFILES+1] = material.."_"..i end end for _, edge in ipairs({"n","e","s","w"}) do TFILES[#TFILES+1] = "shore_"..edge end for _, sprite in ipairs({"act_bear","act_boar","act_cat","act_deer","act_dog","act_leopard","act_raccoon","act_tiger","act_wolf"}) do TFILES[#TFILES+1] = sprite end

GTV.decodeArchitecturePNG(encoded) local out={} for i=1,#encoded,4 do local a,b,c,d=encoded:byte(i,i+3) local value=architectureB64[a]*262144+architectureB64[b]*4096 +(architectureB64[c] or 0)*64+(architectureB64[d] or 0) out[#out+1]=string.char(math.floor(value/65536)%256) if c~=61 then out[#out+1]=string.char(math.floor(value/256)%256) end if d~=61 then out[#out+1]=string.char(value%256) end end return table.concat(out) end GTV.embeddedWritten={} function GTV.installArchitectureTile(name,size) local tiles=KOREAN_PNG[tostring(size)] local encoded=tiles and tiles[name] if not encoded then return false end local key=size.."/"..name if GTV.embeddedWritten[key] then return true end local path=TDIR.."/s"..size.."/"..name..".png" local ok=pcall(function() local f=assert(io.open(path,"wb")) f:write(GTV.decodeArchitecturePNG(encoded));f:close() end) if ok then GTV.embeddedWritten[key]=true end return ok end
function GTV.ensureTiles(size) size = size or GTV.size if GTV.haveSize[size] then return end GTV.haveSize[size] = true local sdir = TDIR .. "/s" .. size pcall(function() lfs.mkdir(sdir) end) local mark = sdir .. "/ver" .. GTV.TILEVER .. ".txt" local force = not (io.exists and io.exists(mark)) for _, f in ipairs(TFILES) do local lp = sdir .. "/" .. f .. ".png" if not GTV.installArchitectureTile(f,size) and (force or not validPng(lp)) then pcall(downloadFile, lp, TBASE .. "s" .. size .. "/" .. f .. ".png") end end pcall(function() local h = io.open(mark, "w"); if h then h:write("ok"); h:close() end end) end
function GTV.ensureLightTiles() if GTV.haveLightIcons or GTV.haveSize[16] then return end GTV.haveLightIcons=true pcall(function() lfs.mkdir(TDIR.."/s16") end) for _,f in ipairs({"ceiling_light_on","ceiling_light_off"}) do local path=TDIR.."/s16/"..f..".png" if not validPng(path) then pcall(downloadFile,path,TBASE.."s16/"..f..".png") end end end
function GTV.makeWin() if GTV.win then return end GTV.win = Geyser.Label:new({name = "GTVwin", x = "28%", y = "10%", width = 560, height = 600}) GTV.win:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(8,10,14,246); border: 2px solid #5a8ac8; border-radius: 8px;") GTV.hdr = Geyser.Label:new({name = "GTVhdr", x = 8, y = 4, width = 540, height = 22}, GTV.win) GTV.hdr:setStyleSheet("background: transparent;") GTV.win:hide() end
-- 오버레이 레이어는 마우스 통과(clickthrough) — 안 하면 틴트/원뿔/안개가 호버·클릭을 전부 삼킴! local THRU = {decal=1, shore=1, shade=1, fx=1, susdot=1, facedot=1, cone=1, tint=1, wx=1, glow=1, fogp=1} local function lbl(layer, i) GTV.P[layer] = GTV.P[layer] or {} local t = GTV.P[layer] if not t[i] then t[i] = Geyser.Label:new({name = "GTV_" .. layer .. "_" .. i, x = 0, y = 0, width = 8, height = 8}, GTV.win) t[i]._css = nil; t[i]._geo = nil if THRU[layer] then pcall(function() t[i]:enableClickthrough() end) end GTV.zdirty = true end return t[i] end local function sty(l, css) if l._css ~= css then l._css = css; l:setStyleSheet(css) end end local function geo(l, x, y, w2, h2) local g = x .. "," .. y .. "," .. w2 .. "," .. h2 if l._geo ~= g then l._geo = g; l:move(x, y); l:resize(w2, h2) end l:show() end local function hideRest(layer, n) local t = GTV.P[layer] or {} for i = n + 1, #t do t[i]:hide() end end local function imgcss(f, extra) return "border-image: url(" .. tp(f) .. "); background: transparent;" .. (extra or "") end function GTV.gcss(rgbA, rgbB, cx, cy, rad) cx = cx or 0.5; cy = cy or 0.5; rad = rad or 0.5 return "background: qradialgradient(cx:" .. cx .. ", cy:" .. cy .. ", radius:" .. rad .. ", fx:" .. cx .. ", fy:" .. cy .. ", stop:0 rgba(" .. rgbA .. "), stop:0.55 rgba(" .. rgbB .. "), stop:1 rgba(0,0,0,0)); border:0;" end -- 가로등 깜빡임 css = 현재 GTV.frame(0.4초 틱으로만 증가) 기반. render·tick 둘 다 이걸 써서 -- 이동(render 빈발)해도 같은 프레임이면 같은 밝기 → 이동=깜빡임 동기화 버그 방지. function GTV.lampStyle(l, ph) local fk = 0.70 + 0.30 * math.sin(GTV.frame * 0.55 + ph) local ia = math.max(0, math.min(255, math.floor(85 * fk))) local oa = math.max(0, math.min(255, math.floor(30 * fk))) return GTV.gcss("255,222,130," .. ia, "255,210,110," .. oa, l._gcx, l._gcy, l._grad) end GTV.imgcss = imgcss
-- 진단 로그: '타일로그' 입력으로 최근 이벤트 확인 (룸전환/렌더 오류 추적용) GTV.log = GTV.log or {} local function dlog(msg) local t = GTV.log t[#t + 1] = os.date("%H:%M:%S") .. " " .. msg if #t > 40 then table.remove(t, 1) end end function GTV.requestRefresh(reason) local now = os.clock() if GTV._reqAt and now - GTV._reqAt < 1.0 then return end GTV._reqAt = now dlog("Tac 재요청: " .. tostring(reason or "?")) pcall(function() send("_galdam_refresh_tac", false) end) end function GTV.bootstrap(reason) if not GTV.on then return end GTV.makeWin() GTV.ensureTiles() local d = (GaldamTac and GaldamTac.lastData) or (gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.Tac) if d then GTV.lastData = d GTV.fogKey = nil local ok, err = pcall(GTV.render, d) if ok then GTV.win:show() if GaldamTac and GaldamTac.win then GaldamTac.win:hide(); GaldamTac.shown = false end dlog("부트스트랩 렌더: " .. tostring(reason or "?")) return else dlog("부트스트랩 렌더 오류: " .. tostring(err)) end end GTV.requestRefresh(reason or "bootstrap") end function GTV.scheduleBootstrap(reason) if not GTV.on then return end for _, dt in ipairs({0.2, 1.0, 2.5, 5.0, 8.0}) do pcall(function() tempTimer(dt, function() GaldamTileView.bootstrap(reason) end) end) end end

-- 대형 격자 전체를 셀별 Geyser.Label로 만들면 40x40에서 1,800개 이상이 한꺼번에 -- 생성되어 Mudlet이 CTD할 수 있다. 서버 데이터는 그대로 두고 타일뷰만 플레이어 -- 중심 근거리 뷰포트로 잘라 렌더한다. 30x30 이하 격자는 기존 전체뷰 유지. function GTV.viewport(d) if not d or d._viewported then return d end local fw, fh = tonumber(d.w) or 9, tonumber(d.h) or 9 if fw * fh <= 900 or not d.self then return d end local sx, sy = tonumber(d.self[1]), tonumber(d.self[2]) if not sx or not sy then return d end local vw, vh = math.min(21, fw), math.min(21, fh) local x0 = math.max(0, math.min(fw - vw, sx - math.floor(vw / 2))) local y0 = math.max(0, math.min(fh - vh, sy - math.floor(vh / 2))) local v = {} for k, val in pairs(d) do v[k] = val end v.w, v.h = vw, vh v.self = {sx - x0, sy - y0} v._viewported, v._vx, v._vy, v._fullw, v._fullh = true, x0, y0, fw, fh for _, key in ipairs({"struct", "terrain", "cover", "actors", "items", "ground", "fx", "lights"}) do local out = {} for _, e in ipairs(d[key] or {}) do local ex, ey = tonumber(e.x), tonumber(e.y) if ex and ey and ex >= x0 and ex < x0 + vw and ey >= y0 and ey < y0 + vh then local n = {} for ek, ev in pairs(e) do n[ek] = ev end n.x, n.y = ex - x0, ey - y0 out[#out + 1] = n end end v[key] = out end v.roof = {} for _, r in ipairs(d.roof or {}) do local rx0,ry0,rx1,ry1 = tonumber(r[1]),tonumber(r[2]),tonumber(r[3]),tonumber(r[4]) if rx0 and ry0 and rx1 and ry1 then local left,top = math.max(0,rx0-x0),math.max(0,ry0-y0) local right,bottom = math.min(vw-1,rx1-x0),math.min(vh-1,ry1-y0) if left<=right and top<=bottom then v.roof[#v.roof+1]={left,top,right,bottom} end end end return v end
-- Visual identity is independent from k="npc" (AI/cones/suspicion semantics). local ACTOR_SPRITES = {act_bear=true,act_boar=true,act_cat=true,act_deer=true,act_dog=true,act_leopard=true,act_raccoon=true,act_tiger=true,act_wild=true,act_wolf=true} function GTV.actorSprite(a) local f = (a.k == "npc") and "act_npc" or ((a.k == "player") and "act_player" or "act_wild") local an = a.n or "" if a.k == "npc" and (an:find("순경") or an:find("경찰") or an:find("수사관") or an:find("경위")) then f = "act_cop" end local id = tonumber(a.id) if a.k == "npc" and id and id > 0 and ACTOR_SPRITES[a.sprite or ""] then return a.sprite end return f end
-- Merge uncovered row spans into rectangles; roofs stay dry without one label per cell. function GTV.weatherRects(d) local w, h = tonumber(d.w) or 9, tonumber(d.h) or 9 local roof = d.roof or {} if #roof == 0 then return {{0,0,w-1,h-1}} end local function covered(x,y) for _, r in ipairs(roof) do local x0,y0,x1,y1 = tonumber(r[1]),tonumber(r[2]),tonumber(r[3]),tonumber(r[4]) if x0 and y0 and x1 and y1 and x>=x0 and x<=x1 and y>=y0 and y<=y1 then return true end end return false end local rects, active = {}, {} for y=0,h-1 do local row, x = {}, 0 while x<w do if covered(x,y) then x=x+1 else local left=x while x<w and not covered(x,y) do x=x+1 end local key=left..":"..(x-1) local r=active[key] if r then r[4]=y else r={left,y,x-1,y}; rects[#rects+1]=r end row[key]=r end end active=row end return rects end
-- Real ceiling fixtures arrive separately: never infer them from cover or names. local function realStreetLamp(c) local id=tonumber(c.id) return c.k=="lamp" and id and id>0 and (c.on==true or tonumber(c.on)==1) end local function realLights(d) local out,seen={},{} local w,h=tonumber(d.w) or 9,tonumber(d.h) or 9 for _,c in ipairs(d.lights or {}) do local id,x,y=tonumber(c.id),tonumber(c.x),tonumber(c.y) if c.k=="ceiling_light" and id and id>0 and id==math.floor(id) and not seen[id] and x and y and x==math.floor(x) and y==math.floor(y) and x>=0 and y>=0 and x<w and y<h then out[#out+1]={id=id,x=x,y=y,on=(c.on==true or tonumber(c.on)==1),n=c.n or "천장 전등",k=c.k} seen[id]=true end end return out end
