{["321980"]="brick",["634428"]="stone",["634430"]="block",["634431"]="stone",["634432"]="block",["634439"]="brick",["634441"]="block",["634443"]="stone",["634446"]="block",["634447"]="stone",["634449"]="brick"}
-- Art is a skin over exact server structures. Any changed footprint falls -- back to ordinary autotiles; door/window state remains live server data. local function architecturalKind(kind) if kind=="door_open" or kind=="door_broken" then return "door" end if kind=="window_open" or kind=="window_broken" then return "window" end return kind end function GTV.architecture(d) local rid=tostring(d.rid or ""):gsub("#","") local result={files={},fence=KOREAN_FENCES[rid]} local groups=KOREAN_BUILDINGS[rid] if not groups then return result end local map={} for _,s in ipairs(d.struct or {}) do map[tonumber(s.x)..","..tonumber(s.y)]=s.t end for _,group in ipairs(groups) do local matches=true for _,cell in ipairs(group) do if architecturalKind(map[cell[1]..","..cell[2]])~=cell[3] then matches=false;break end end if matches then for _,cell in ipairs(group) do result[cell[1]..","..cell[2]]=cell for index=4,6 do result.files[cell[index]]=true end end end end return result end GTV.archFiles={} function GTV.ensureArchitecture(art,size) local now=os.time() for name in pairs(art.files) do local key=size.."/"..name local status=GTV.archFiles[key] if status~=true then local path=TDIR.."/s"..size.."/"..name..".png" if GTV.installArchitectureTile(name,size) or validPng(path) then GTV.archFiles[key]=true end end end end function GTV.archAssetReady(name) local key=GTV.size.."/"..name if GTV.archFiles[key]==true then return true end if validPng(tp(name)) then GTV.archFiles[key]=true;return true end return false end function GTV.architectureSprite(art,map,x,y,ox,oy) local cell=art[(x+(ox or 0))..","..(y+(oy or 0))] local kind=map[x..","..y] if not cell or architecturalKind(kind)~=cell[3] then return nil end if kind=="window_head" or kind=="door_head" then kind=map[x..","..(y+1)] end local index=(kind=="window_broken" or kind=="door_broken") and 6 or (kind=="window_open" or kind=="door_open") and 5 or 4 local name=cell[index] return GTV.archAssetReady(name) and name or nil end function GTV.fenceSprite(map,x,y,style) local mask=0 for _,edge in ipairs({{0,-1,1},{1,0,2},{0,1,4},{-1,0,8}}) do local kind=map[(x+edge[1])..","..(y+edge[2])] if kind=="fence" or kind=="gate" or kind=="gate_open" then mask=mask+edge[3] end end local family=(style=="block" or style=="brick") and ("kr_fence_"..style) or "kr_fence_stone" return family.."_"..mask end
-- Diffuse skylight is transmitted by the server; indoor weather stays sheltered. local function skyLightLevel(d,lights,x,y,sx,sy,litrad) local level=tonumber(d.daylight) if not level then return nil end local v=math.max(0,math.min(1,level/100)) for _,light in ipairs(lights) do if light.on then local dist=math.sqrt((x-light.x)^2+(y-light.y)^2) if dist<=6 then v=math.max(v,0.96-dist*0.12) end end end if litrad>0 and sx and sy then local dist=math.max(math.abs(x-sx),math.abs(y-sy)) if dist<=litrad+1 then v=math.max(v,1-dist/(litrad+1.7)) end end return math.min(1,v) end
function GTV.render(d) if not d then return end local architecture=GTV.architecture(d) d = GTV.viewport(d) GTV.makeWin() local w = tonumber(d.w) or 9 local h = tonumber(d.h) or 9 local biome = d.biome or "indoor" local outdoor = (biome == "forest" or biome == "road" or biome == "sea" or biome == "ocean" or biome == "village") local watery = (biome == "sea" or biome == "ocean") local tone = tonumber(d.tone) or 3 local dark = tonumber(d.dark) or 0 local litrad = tonumber(d.litrad) or 0 local weather = d.weather or "clear" local watch = (tonumber(d.watch) or 0) == 1 local sx = d.self and tonumber(d.self[1]) local sy = d.self and tonumber(d.self[2]) -- 셀 크기: 화면 크기 비례 예산(가로 62%/세로 80%) → 사전생성 타일 크기로 양자화(무리스케일=또렷) local mw, mh = 1280, 800 pcall(function() mw, mh = getMainWindowSize() end) local rawCS = math.floor(math.min((mw * 0.62 - 16) / math.max(1, w), (mh * 0.80 - 36) / math.max(1, h))) local CS = 16 for _, s in ipairs({32, 28, 24, 20}) do if rawCS >= s then CS = s; break end end GTV.size = CS GTV.ensureTiles(CS) GTV.ensureArchitecture(architecture,CS) local PX, PY = 8, 28 local wg = w .. "x" .. h .. "@" .. CS if GTV._wingeo ~= wg then GTV._wingeo = wg pcall(function() local pxw = w * CS + PX * 2 GTV.win:resize(pxw, h * CS + PY + 8) -- 좌측 본문 텍스트 안 가리게 오른쪽으로: 화면 34% 지점 이후에서 중앙 local wx = math.min(math.max(8, mw - pxw - 16), math.max(math.floor(mw * 0.34), math.floor((mw - pxw) * 0.62))) GTV.win:move(wx, math.max(8, math.floor(mh * 0.06))) end) end local nm = (gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.Room and gmcp.Galdam.Room.name) or "전술 격자" local tnames = {"새벽", "아침", "낮", "저녁", "노을", "밤"} local sub = (outdoor or tonumber(d.daylight) ~= nil) and (" <span style='color:#8890a4'>(" .. (tnames[tone] or "") .. (weather ~= "clear" and (" · " .. weather) or "") .. ")</span>") or "" if tonumber(d.daylight) then sub=sub .. " <span style='color:#aebca0'>· 비닐 채광</span>" end if d._fullw then sub = sub .. " <span style='color:#778397'>[" .. w .. "×" .. h .. " 근거리 / 전체 " .. d._fullw .. "×" .. d._fullh .. "]</span>" end GTV.hdr:echo("<b style='color:#9fc6ef'>⌖ " .. nm .. "</b>" .. sub .. " <span style='color:#667'>[타일뷰]</span>")
local stmap, tmap = {}, {} for _, s in ipairs(d.struct or {}) do stmap[tonumber(s.x) .. "," .. tonumber(s.y)] = s.t end -- 실내 룸은 벽/문/창이 struct가 아니라 cover(tac_grid)로 옴 → 구조물 kind는 stmap에 합류 (벽/문 풀셀타일+fog 적용) for _, c in ipairs(d.cover or {}) do if SFULL[c.k] or SOVER[c.k] or c.k == "fence" then local key=tonumber(c.x)..","..tonumber(c.y) if not stmap[key] then stmap[key]=c.k end end end for _, t in ipairs(d.terrain or {}) do tmap[tonumber(t.x) .. "," .. tonumber(t.y)] = t.t end -- 애니 레지스트리: 경량 틱이 이 라벨들'만' 갱신 (전체 재렌더 = 프레임 출렁임 원인이라 폐지) GTV.A = {pol = {}, fire = {}, water = {}, lamp = {}}
-- Native darkness and real powered fixtures determine illumination. -- 시야음영(fog) 캐시 (글리프판 v8과 동일 DDA) local fog if sx and sy then local fkey = tostring(d._vx or 0) .. "," .. tostring(d._vy or 0) .. "|" .. sx .. "," .. sy .. "|" .. w .. "x" .. h if GTV.fogKey == fkey and GTV.fog then fog = GTV.fog else fog = {} for yy = 0, h - 1 do for xx = 0, w - 1 do local dx, dy = xx - sx, yy - sy local steps = math.max(math.abs(dx), math.abs(dy)) for i = 1, steps - 1 do local cx = sx + math.floor(dx * i / steps + 0.5) local cy = sy + math.floor(dy * i / steps + 0.5) if SOLID[stmap[cx .. "," .. cy] or ""] then fog[xx .. "," .. yy] = true; break end end end end GTV.fog = fog; GTV.fogKey = fkey end end -- 실외 광원맵: 가로등(cover lamp) 주변 밝기 (밤/악천후 어둠막 fogp를 뚫음) local litmap = {} if outdoor then for _, c in ipairs(d.cover or {}) do if realStreetLamp(c) then local lx, ly = tonumber(c.x), tonumber(c.y) for ddy = -4, 4 do for ddx = -4, 4 do local dd = math.sqrt(ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy) -- 유클리드 = 원형 빛범위 local v = 1.0 - dd / 5.5 if v > 0 then local k = (lx + ddx) .. "," .. (ly + ddy) if (litmap[k] or 0) < v then litmap[k] = v end end end end end end end -- 손전등 빔: 진행방향(faceDir) 직선 + 양옆 1칸 평행 = 붙은 폭3 빔 × 8칸 local beammap = {} if outdoor and litrad > 0 and sx then local fd = GTV.faceDir or {0, -1} local perp = {-fd[2], fd[1]} for off = -1, 1 do for step = 1, 8 do local bk = (sx + fd[1] * step + perp[1] * off) .. "," .. (sy + fd[2] * step + perp[2] * off) local bv = 1.0 - step * 0.04 if (beammap[bk] or 0) < bv then beammap[bk] = bv end end end end local skyLights=realLights(d) local OUTAMB = {[1]=0.40, [2]=0.85, [3]=1.0, [4]=0.50, [5]=0.28, [6]=0.16} local function lm(x, y) -- 시야 차단(벽 너머): 시야에 포착될 때만 보임 = 낮밤 무관 거의 미파악 if fog and fog[x .. "," .. y] and not (sx == x and sy == y) then return 0.06 end if not outdoor then local sky=skyLightLevel(d,skyLights,x,y,sx,sy,litrad) if sky then return sky end if dark < 1 then return 1.0 end if litrad <= 0 or not sx then return 0.0 end local dist = math.max(math.abs(x - sx), math.abs(y - sy)) if dist > litrad + 1 then return 0.0 end return math.max(0.14, 1.0 - dist / (litrad + 1.7)) end -- 실외: 밤엔 광원 밖이 거의 암흑(FOW). 광원/시야만 또렷 local amb = OUTAMB[tone] or 1.0 if weather == "fog" then amb = math.min(amb, 0.58) elseif weather == "storm" then amb = amb * 0.40 elseif weather == "rain" then amb = amb * 0.72 end local v = amb -- 어둠 기본 시야: 캐릭터 반경 ~3칸 원형(유클리드). if sx then local pd = math.sqrt((x - sx) * (x - sx) + (y - sy) * (y - sy)) if pd <= 3.2 then v = math.max(v, 0.62 - pd * 0.06) end end -- 가로등 바닥 reveal 제거: 칸단위(네모) reveal이 둥근 빛무리(glow)와 겹쳐 보임 → 부드러운 오브만 -- v = math.max(v, litmap[x .. "," .. y] or 0) -- 손전등: 진행방향으로 둥근 빛 웅덩이 여러 개(부드러운 원형 빔). 네모 평행빔 폐기. if litrad > 0 and sx then local fd = GTV.faceDir or {0, -1} -- 발밑(반경2) local pdf = math.sqrt((x - sx) * (x - sx) + (y - sy) * (y - sy)) if pdf <= 2 then v = math.max(v, 0.60 - pdf * 0.05) end -- 진행방향 원뿔 빔(앞으로 쭉 뻗으며 갈수록 넓어짐) local rx = x - sx; local ry = y - sy local proj = rx * fd[1] + ry * fd[2] if proj > 0 and proj <= 7 then local perp = math.abs(rx * (-fd[2]) + ry * fd[1]) if perp <= 0.7 + proj * 0.5 then v = math.max(v, 0.74 - proj * 0.06) end end end if sx and (weather == "fog" or weather == "storm") then local d3 = math.max(math.abs(x - sx), math.abs(y - sy)) local vis = (weather == "fog") and 6 or 4 if d3 > vis then v = v * math.max(0.15, 1 - (d3 - vis) * 0.10) end end return math.min(1.0, v) end
-- 시야 내(lm 충분) 객체 id 집합 → 우측 패널 필터용 (시야 밖 사람/물건은 패널서도 숨김) GaldamTac.visibleIds = {} GaldamTac.nearIds = {} if sx then for _, lst in ipairs({d.actors or {}, d.items or {}, d.cover or {}, realLights(d)}) do for _, o in ipairs(lst) do local oid = o.id and tonumber(o.id) if oid and oid > 0 then local ox, oy = tonumber(o.x), tonumber(o.y) if ox and oy and lm(ox, oy) >= 0.28 then GaldamTac.visibleIds[tostring(oid)] = true if math.max(math.abs(ox - sx), math.abs(oy - sy)) <= 1 then GaldamTac.nearIds[tostring(oid)] = true end end end end end end
-- ① ground (+풀셀 struct) local gi = 0 for y = 0, h - 1 do for x = 0, w - 1 do gi = gi + 1 local l = lbl("ground", gi) local key = x .. "," .. y local st = stmap[key] local f local architectureFile=GTV.architectureSprite(architecture,stmap,x,y,d._vx,d._vy) if architectureFile then f=architectureFile elseif st and ROOFFILE[st] then f = GTV.roofSprite(st,stmap,x,y) elseif st and GTV.apertureSprite(st,stmap,x,y) then f = GTV.apertureSprite(st,stmap,x,y) elseif st and SFULL[st] and not WALLFILE[st] then f = SFULL[st] else f = groundFile(biome, d.floor, x + (d._vx or 0), y + (d._vy or 0), tmap[key]) end -- 바닥은 이미지 실패시 검정 대신 흙색 폴백 (다운로드 중 검은 칸 방지) sty(l, "border-image: url(" .. tp(f) .. "); background-color: #4a4238;") -- 일반 바닥(지형)엔 툴팁 없음 — 벽/문/창문 등 struct만 (사용자 요청 2026-06-11) setTip(l, st and tipOf(st) or nil) geo(l, PX + x * CS, PY + y * CS, CS, CS) -- 물 애니 등록: struct뿐 아니라 terrain(나무바닥 등) 깔린 칸도 제외 — 안 그러면 경량틱이 물로 덧칠 if watery and not st and not tmap[key] and w * h <= 400 then GTV.A.water[#GTV.A.water + 1] = l end end end hideRest("ground", gi)
-- 해안 가장자리: 실제 물 지형에만 모래/몽돌/갯벌과 만나는 얇은 물결을 겹친다. local shoreCount = 0 local naturalCoast = {sand=1,mudflat=1,pebbles=1,rockground=1} for y = 0, h-1 do for x = 0, w-1 do local key = x..","..y if not stmap[key] and (tmap[key] == "water" or (watery and not tmap[key])) then for _, edge in ipairs({{0,-1,"n"},{1,0,"e"},{0,1,"s"},{-1,0,"w"}}) do if naturalCoast[tmap[(x+edge[1])..","..(y+edge[2])] or ""] then shoreCount = shoreCount+1 local sl = lbl("shore",shoreCount) sty(sl,imgcss("shore_"..edge[3])); geo(sl,PX+x*CS,PY+y*CS,CS,CS) end end end end end hideRest("shore",shoreCount)
-- ② 데칼(바닥 흔적 + 주차선). 페인트는 실제 아스팔트 위 RGBA로 합성한다. local di = 0 for key,t in pairs(tmap) do if PARKING[t] and not stmap[key] then local x,y=key:match("(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+)"); x,y=tonumber(x),tonumber(y) di=di+1 local l=lbl("decal",di) sty(l,imgcss(t));geo(l,PX+x*CS,PY+y*CS,CS,CS) end end for _, g in ipairs(d.ground or {}) do local f if g.t == "blood" then f = "blood_" .. math.min(3, math.max(1, math.floor((tonumber(g.l) or 1) / 2) + 1)) elseif g.t == "wet" then f = "wetg" elseif g.t == "snow" then f = "snowg" elseif g.t == "glass" then f = "glass" elseif g.t == "mess" then f = "mess" end if f then di = di + 1 local l = lbl("decal", di) sty(l, imgcss(f)); geo(l, PX + tonumber(g.x) * CS, PY + tonumber(g.y) * CS, CS, CS) end end hideRest("decal", di)
-- ③ 벽그림자(AO) local si = 0 for k, t in pairs(stmap) do if SHADE[t] then local x, y = k:match("(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+)"); x, y = tonumber(x), tonumber(y) if y + 1 < h and not stmap[x .. "," .. (y + 1)] then si = si + 1 local l = lbl("shade", si) sty(l, "background: qlineargradient(x1:0,y1:0,x2:0,y2:1, stop:0 rgba(0,0,0,95), stop:1 rgba(0,0,0,0)); border:0;") geo(l, PX + x * CS, PY + (y + 1) * CS, CS, math.floor(CS * 0.45)) end end end hideRest("shade", si)
-- ④ 오브젝트(가구/차량/투명 struct) local oi = 0 local function objAt(x, y, f, id, name, kindTip) oi = oi + 1 local l = lbl("obj", oi) sty(l, imgcss(f)); geo(l, PX + x * CS, PY + y * CS, CS, CS) -- 실물객체(id>0)=객체이름, 셀(id없음)=종류 한글명 우선 (셀의 name은 영문 kind라 한글명을 덮는 버그) local realObj = id and tonumber(id) and tonumber(id) > 0 setTip(l, (realObj and name) or kindTip or name) -- 콜백은 대상이 바뀐 라벨만 재설정 (매 렌더 클로저 재생성 = 프레임 출렁임 원인) local ck = tostring(id or 0) .. ":" .. (name or "") if l._cid ~= ck then l._cid = ck pcall(function() if id and tonumber(id) and tonumber(id) > 0 then l:setClickCallback(function() GaldamUI.tacClick(tostring(id), name or "?") end) else l:setClickCallback(function() end) end end) end end for k, t in pairs(stmap) do if WALLFILE[t] then local x, y = k:match("(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+)"); x,y = tonumber(x),tonumber(y) objAt(x,y,GTV.wallSprite(t,stmap,x,y),nil,nil,tipOf(t)) elseif SOVER[t] then local x, y = k:match("(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+)") objAt(tonumber(x), tonumber(y), GTV.architectureSprite(architecture,stmap,tonumber(x),tonumber(y),d._vx,d._vy) or GTV.apertureSprite(t,stmap,tonumber(x),tonumber(y)) or SOVER[t], nil, nil, tipOf(t)) elseif t == "fence" then local x, y = k:match("(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+)"); x, y = tonumber(x), tonumber(y) objAt(x,y,GTV.fenceSprite(stmap,x,y,architecture.fence),nil,nil,tipOf("fence")) end end for _, c in ipairs(d.cover or {}) do if not (SFULL[c.k] or SOVER[c.k] or c.k == "fence") then local f = OBJF[c.k] or "prop" objAt(tonumber(c.x), tonumber(c.y), f, c.id, c.n, tipOf(c.k)) end end hideRest("obj", oi)
-- ⑤ 아이템 local ii = 0 for _, it in ipairs(d.items or {}) do ii = ii + 1 local l = lbl("item", ii) local vehicle = it.sprite == "boat" and tonumber(it.entity_id) and tonumber(it.entity_id) > 0 sty(l, imgcss(vehicle and "boat" or "loot")) local inset = vehicle and 0 or math.floor(CS * 0.15) local extent = vehicle and CS or math.floor(CS * 0.7) geo(l, PX + tonumber(it.x) * CS + inset, PY + tonumber(it.y) * CS + inset, extent, extent) local clickId = (vehicle and tonumber(it.action_id) and tonumber(it.action_id) > 0) and it.action_id or it.id local ck = tostring(clickId or 0) .. ":" .. (it.n or "") if l._cid ~= ck then l._cid = ck pcall(function() if clickId then l:setClickCallback(function() GaldamUI.tacClick(tostring(clickId), it.n or "아이템") end) end if GaldamUI and GaldamUI.attachTip then GaldamUI.attachTip(l, it.n or "아이템") end end) end end hideRest("item", ii)
-- ⑥ FX: 불(프레임) + 연기(GaldamTac CA 재사용) local fi = 0 for _, f in ipairs(d.fx or {}) do if f.t == "fire" then fi = fi + 1 local l = lbl("fx", fi) sty(l, imgcss("fire_" .. (GTV.frame % 2))) geo(l, PX + tonumber(f.x) * CS, PY + tonumber(f.y) * CS, CS, CS) GTV.A.fire[#GTV.A.fire + 1] = l end end for k, c in pairs((GaldamTac and GaldamTac.smoke) or {}) do if c.d and c.d >= 1.2 then local x, y = k:match("(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+)"); x, y = tonumber(x), tonumber(y) x, y = x and (x - (d._vx or 0)), y and (y - (d._vy or 0)) if x and x >= 0 and x < w and y >= 0 and y < h then fi = fi + 1 local l = lbl("fx", fi) local f = (c.t == "gas") and "smoke_gas" or ((c.t == "white") and "smoke_white" or "smoke_gray") sty(l, imgcss(f)); geo(l, PX + x * CS, PY + y * CS, CS, CS) end end end hideRest("fx", fi)
-- ⑦ 액터 + 의심도 점 local ai, ui = 0, 0 local function actorAt(x, y, f, name, id) ai = ai + 1 local l = lbl("actor", ai) sty(l, imgcss(f)); geo(l, PX + x * CS, PY + y * CS, CS, CS) local ck = tostring(id or 0) .. ":" .. (name or "") if l._cid ~= ck then l._cid = ck pcall(function() -- id 없는 액터(=나)는 콜백을 비워야 함: 풀 라벨에 남은 이전 NPC 콜백이 그대로 살면 "나 클릭=딴사람" 버그 if id and tonumber(id) and tonumber(id) > 0 then l:setClickCallback(function() GaldamUI.tacClick(tostring(id), name or "?") end) else l:setClickCallback(function() end) end -- NPC/동물 호버 = 툴팁 + 실시간 신체창 요청 (1초 디바운스) if id and tonumber(id) and tonumber(id) > 0 and f ~= "act_player" then l:setOnEnter(function() if GaldamUI and GaldamUI.showTip then GaldamUI.showTip(name or "?") end local now = os.clock() if not l._bodyT or now - l._bodyT > 1.0 then l._bodyT = now; send("_galdambody " .. tostring(id), false) end end) l:setOnLeave(function() if GaldamUI and GaldamUI.hideTip then GaldamUI.hideTip() end end) elseif GaldamUI and GaldamUI.attachTip then GaldamUI.attachTip(l, name or "?") end end) end end local fdi = 0 for _, a in ipairs(d.actors or {}) do local x, y = tonumber(a.x), tonumber(a.y) -- 실외 야간 FOW: 광원/시야 밖(lm 낮음)의 액터는 미파악 → 숨김 (플레이어 본인은 아래서 별도 렌더) if not (sx == x and sy == y) and not (outdoor and lm(x, y) < 0.28) then local f = GTV.actorSprite(a) local sus = tonumber(a.sus) or 0 actorAt(x, y, f, a.n, a.id) if a.k == "npc" and sus > 0 then ui = ui + 1 local dl = lbl("susdot", ui) local col = (sus >= 61) and "rgba(255,70,55,235)" or ((sus >= 31) and "rgba(255,150,60,235)" or "rgba(245,210,80,235)") sty(dl, "background-color: " .. col .. "; border-radius: " .. math.floor(CS * 0.12) .. "px; border: 1px solid rgba(20,20,24,200);") geo(dl, PX + x * CS + CS - math.floor(CS * 0.3), PY + y * CS, math.floor(CS * 0.25), math.floor(CS * 0.25)) end -- 시선 방향 표식 — 평시에도 상시 표시 (원뿔만 경계상황 전용) if a.k == "npc" and a.f then local fx2, fy2 = tonumber(a.f[1]) or 0, tonumber(a.f[2]) or 0 if fx2 ~= 0 or fy2 ~= 0 then local dn = ((fy2 < 0) and "n" or (fy2 > 0) and "s" or "") .. ((fx2 > 0) and "e" or (fx2 < 0) and "w" or "") fdi = fdi + 1 local fl = lbl("facedot", fdi) sty(fl, imgcss("arr_" .. dn)) local sz = math.max(8, math.floor(CS * 0.42)) local cxp = PX + x * CS + math.floor(CS / 2 - sz / 2 + fx2 * CS * 0.34) local cyp = PY + y * CS + math.floor(CS / 2 - sz / 2 + fy2 * CS * 0.34) geo(fl, cxp, cyp, sz, sz) end end end end if sx and sy then actorAt(sx, sy, "act_player", "나") end hideRest("actor", ai); hideRest("susdot", ui); hideRest("facedot", fdi)
-- Actual ceiling fixtures: small corner overlays keep floor/actors usable. -- They never enter stmap, cover, pathfinding, or collision calculations. local lightList=realLights(d) if #lightList>0 then GTV.ensureLightTiles() end local li=0 for _,c in ipairs(lightList) do if lm(c.x,c.y)>=0.28 then li=li+1 local l=lbl("light",li) local sprite="ceiling_light_"..(c.on and "on" or "off") sty(l,"border-image: url("..TDIR.."/s16/"..sprite..".png); background: transparent;") geo(l,PX+c.x*CS+CS-16,PY+c.y*CS,16,16) local ck=tostring(c.id)..":"..tostring(c.on) if l._cid~=ck then l._cid=ck pcall(function() l:setClickCallback(function() GaldamUI.tacClick(tostring(c.id),c.n) end) end) setTip(l,c.n..(c.on and " (켜짐)" or " (꺼짐)")) end end end hideRest("light",li)
-- ⑧ 시야원뿔(rgba 오버레이) — 글리프판과 동일 기하 local ci = 0 for _, a in ipairs(d.actors or {}) do if a.k == "npc" and a.f then local ox, oy = tonumber(a.x), tonumber(a.y) local fx, fy = tonumber(a.f[1]), tonumber(a.f[2]) local sr = tonumber(a.sr) or 5 local ct = tonumber(a.ct) or 1 local sus = tonumber(a.sus) or 0 if ox and fx and (watch or sus > 0) and (fx ~= 0 or fy ~= 0) then local cr, cg, cb = 70, 200, 90 if sus >= 61 then cr, cg, cb = 235, 70, 60 elseif sus >= 31 then cr, cg, cb = 235, 150, 60 elseif sus >= 1 then cr, cg, cb = 220, 200, 70 end for cy = math.max(0, oy - sr), math.min(h - 1, oy + sr) do for cx = math.max(0, ox - sr), math.min(w - 1, ox + sr) do local vx, vy = cx - ox, cy - oy local dist = math.max(math.abs(vx), math.abs(vy)) if dist >= 1 and dist <= sr then local fdot = fx * vx + fy * vy local fcr = fx * vy - fy * vx if fdot > 0 and math.abs(fcr) <= fdot * ct then ci = ci + 1 local l = lbl("cone", ci) -- 또렷하게: 바닥 알파 40 + 거리감쇠, 같은 색 얇은 테두리 (틴트 위 레이어라 안 씻김) local aint = 40 + math.floor((1 - dist / (sr + 1.5)) * 85) sty(l, "background-color: rgba(" .. cr .. "," .. cg .. "," .. cb .. "," .. aint .. "); border:1px solid rgba(" .. cr .. "," .. cg .. "," .. cb .. ",110);") geo(l, PX + cx * CS, PY + cy * CS, CS, CS) end end end end end end end hideRest("cone", ci)
-- ⑨ 시간대 틴트(단일) + 날씨 local tl = lbl("tint", 1) local tcss = outdoor and TONETINT[tone] or nil if weather == "fog" and outdoor then tcss = "rgba(180,183,188,60)" elseif weather == "storm" and outdoor then tcss = "rgba(28,38,66,95)" end if tcss then sty(tl, "background-color: " .. tcss .. "; border:0;") geo(tl, PX, PY, w * CS, h * CS) else tl:hide() end local wi = 0 GTV.A.wxls = {} if outdoor and (weather == "rain" or weather == "snow" or weather == "storm") then local wt = (weather == "snow") and "snow" or "rain" for _, r in ipairs(GTV.weatherRects(d)) do wi = wi+1 local wl = lbl("wx", wi) sty(wl, imgcss(wt .. "_" .. (GTV.frame % 3))) geo(wl, PX+r[1]*CS, PY+r[2]*CS, (r[3]-r[1]+1)*CS, (r[4]-r[2]+1)*CS) GTV.A.wxls[#GTV.A.wxls+1]=wl if wi==1 then GTV.A.wxl=wl end end GTV.A.wxt=wt end hideRest("wx",wi)
-- ⑩ 빛무리(radial): 가로등(야간) + 경광등(점멸) + 불 local gli = 0 local function glowAt(x, y, R, rgbA, rgbB) gli = gli + 1 local l = lbl("glow", gli) -- 항상 정사각(완전 원형 O) + 격자 안: 가장자리 가까우면 반경만 축소(타원 0 / 창밖번짐 방지) local eR = math.min(R, x, w - 1 - x, y, h - 1 - y) if eR < 0.5 then l:hide(); return l end local hw = (eR + 0.5) * CS l._gcx = 0.5; l._gcy = 0.5; l._grad = 0.5 sty(l, GTV.gcss(rgbA, rgbB)) geo(l, math.floor(PX + x * CS + CS * 0.5 - hw), math.floor(PY + y * CS + CS * 0.5 - hw), math.floor(hw * 2), math.floor(hw * 2)) return l end local lampOn = outdoor and (tone == 1 or tone >= 4) for _, c in ipairs(d.cover or {}) do if lampOn and realStreetLamp(c) then local lx, ly = tonumber(c.x), tonumber(c.y) local ph = lx * 1.7 + ly * 2.3 local l = glowAt(lx, ly, 5, "255,222,130,130", "255,210,110,45") sty(l, GTV.lampStyle(l, ph)) -- 현재 깜빡임 값(이동해도 풀밝기로 안 튐) GTV.A.lamp[#GTV.A.lamp + 1] = {l = l, ph = ph} elseif c.k == "policeL" then local on = (GTV.frame % 2) == 0 local cA = on and "245,60,60,150" or "60,100,245,150" local cB = on and "245,60,60,50" or "60,100,245,50" GTV.A.pol[#GTV.A.pol + 1] = glowAt(tonumber(c.x), tonumber(c.y), 3, cA, cB) end end for _,c in ipairs(lightList) do if c.on and lm(c.x,c.y)>=0.28 then glowAt(c.x,c.y,2,"255,248,193,32","244,234,166,8") end end for _, f in ipairs(d.fx or {}) do if f.t == "fire" then glowAt(tonumber(f.x), tonumber(f.y), 2, "255,150,40,150", "255,120,30,55") end end -- 손전등: 진행방향으로 부드러운 원형 글로우 오브 여러 개(겹쳐서 둥근 빔) — 차가운 흰빛 if litrad > 0 and sx then local fd = GTV.faceDir or {0, -1} -- 진행방향 원뿔 빔: 앞으로 갈수록 넓어지는 둥근 오브들(검빔/두 덩어리 X) — 차가운 흰빛 for k = 1, 6 do glowAt(sx + fd[1] * k, sy + fd[2] * k, 1 + k * 0.5, "225,233,255,24", "205,220,255,8") end end hideRest("glow", gli)
-- ⑪ 시야음영 + 실내 어둠 (셀별 합성) local fpi = 0 for y = 0, h - 1 do for x = 0, w - 1 do local a = 0 if fog and fog[x .. "," .. y] and not (sx == x and sy == y) then a = 150 end local m = lm(x, y) if m < 1.0 then a = math.max(a, math.floor((1 - m) * 250)) end if a > 8 then fpi = fpi + 1 local l = lbl("fogp", fpi) local fr, fgc, fb = 7, 9, 15 if outdoor then if weather == "fog" then fr, fgc, fb = 120, 123, 130 elseif weather == "storm" then fr, fgc, fb = 16, 22, 40 elseif weather == "rain" then fr, fgc, fb = 22, 30, 46 end end sty(l, "background-color: rgba(" .. fr .. "," .. fgc .. "," .. fb .. "," .. a .. "); border:0;") geo(l, PX + x * CS, PY + y * CS, CS, CS) end end end hideRest("fogp", fpi)
zfix() if GTV.on then GTV.win:show() end -- 타일뷰 갱신마다 우측 패널 재렌더 (시야 필터/근접 하이라이트/반짝 반영 — push_tac 시점) pcall(function() if GaldamUI and GaldamUI.renderRoom then GaldamUI.renderRoom() end end)
-- 애니 필요시 틱 (경광등/불/비눈/물/연기) local anim = (#GTV.A.pol > 0) or (#GTV.A.fire > 0) or (#GTV.A.water > 0) or (GTV.A.wxl ~= nil) or (#GTV.A.lamp > 0) if not anim then for _, f in ipairs(d.fx or {}) do if f.t == "smoke" then anim = true; break end end end if not anim and GaldamTac and GaldamTac.smoke and next(GaldamTac.smoke) then anim = true end GTV.needAnim = anim if anim and GTV.on and not GTV.timer then GTV.timer = tempTimer(0.4, "GaldamTileView.tick()") end end
-- 경량 틱: 애니 라벨만 스타일 갱신 (전체 재렌더 금지 — 프레임 안정성). 연기 확산 중에만 풀 렌더 function GTV.tick() GTV.timer = nil if not (GTV.on and GTV.lastData) then return end GTV.frame = GTV.frame + 1 local smoky = GaldamTac and GaldamTac.smoke and next(GaldamTac.smoke) local hasFx = false for _, f in ipairs(GTV.lastData.fx or {}) do if f.t == "fire" or f.t == "smoke" then hasFx = true; break end end if smoky or hasFx then if (GTV.frame % 2) == 0 and GaldamTac and GaldamTac.smokeStep then pcall(GaldamTac.smokeStep, GTV.lastData) end GTV.render(GTV.lastData) else local A = GTV.A or {} local on = (GTV.frame % 2) == 0 local cA = on and "245,60,60,150" or "60,100,245,150" local cB = on and "245,60,60,50" or "60,100,245,50" for _, l in ipairs(A.pol or {}) do if l._css then l._css = nil end; l:setStyleSheet(GTV.gcss(cA, cB, l._gcx, l._gcy, l._grad)) end -- 가로등: 은은하게 밝았다 흐려지는 깜빡임(램프별 위상차 → 살아있는 느낌) for _, e in ipairs(A.lamp or {}) do local c = GTV.lampStyle(e.l, e.ph) e.l._css = c; e.l:setStyleSheet(c) end if A.wxt then local c = imgcss(A.wxt .. "_" .. (GTV.frame % 3)) for _, wl in ipairs(A.wxls or {}) do wl._css=c; wl:setStyleSheet(c) end end for _, l in ipairs(A.water or {}) do local c = imgcss("water_" .. (GTV.frame % 2)); l._css = c; l:setStyleSheet(c) end if GTV.needAnim then GTV.timer = tempTimer(0.4, "GaldamTileView.tick()") end end end
-- 룸 전환 시 풀 라벨의 모든 캐시 무효화 (잔상/스테일 방지 — 룸 바뀔 때만 1회 전체 재도색) function GTV.flushCaches() for ly, pool in pairs(GTV.P or {}) do for _, l in ipairs(pool) do l._css = nil; l._geo = nil; l._cid = nil; l._tip = nil end end GTV.fog = nil; GTV.fogKey = nil; GTV._wingeo = nil end
function GTV.onTac() local d = gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.Tac if not d then return end -- 룸 식별 게이트: 다른 룸의 Tac는 렌더하지 않고 보류 (Room보다 Tac가 먼저 오는 경우 대비) local rm = tonumber(d.rid) if rm and GTV.curRoom and rm ~= GTV.curRoom then -- push_tac은 본인 타겟 푸시 = 이 방에 있다는 뜻. 보류 대신 채택 (Room 도착 순서 의존 제거) dlog("타룸 Tac 채택 (rid=" .. tostring(rm) .. " cur=" .. tostring(GTV.curRoom) .. ")") GTV.curRoom = rm GTV.flushCaches() end GTV.lastData = d GTV.fogKey = nil if GTV.on then local ok, err = pcall(GTV.render, d) if ok then GTV.win:show() else dlog("render 오류: " .. tostring(err)) end end -- 배 조종패드: 조타륜(helm 셀)에 인접(1칸)했을 때만 표시 pcall(function() if GaldamBoatPad then local sx2 = d.self and tonumber(d.self[1]) local sy2 = d.self and tonumber(d.self[2]) local near = false if sx2 then for _, c in ipairs(d.cover or {}) do if c.k == "helm" and math.abs(tonumber(c.x) - sx2) <= 1 and math.abs(tonumber(c.y) - sy2) <= 1 then near = true; break end end end if near then GaldamBoatPad.show() else GaldamBoatPad.hide() end end end) dlog("Tac 수신 (rid=" .. tostring(rm) .. ")") end
function GTV.onRoom() local rids = gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.Room and gmcp.Galdam.Room.roomid local rid = rids and tonumber((tostring(rids):gsub("#", ""))) or nil local changed = (rid ~= GTV.curRoom) GTV.curRoom = rid if not changed then -- 같은 룸의 Room 재푸시(내용물 변화 sigchg) = 뷰 유지! (기존: 무조건 숨김 → "화면 사라짐" 버그) dlog("Room 재수신(같은 룸 " .. tostring(rids) .. ") → 유지") return end dlog("Room 수신 → 룸 전환 (" .. tostring(rids) .. ")") GTV.flushCaches() if GTV.timer then pcall(killTimer, GTV.timer); GTV.timer = nil end -- 새 룸의 Tac를 이미 보유중이면(보류분/직전 수신) 즉시 렌더, 아니면 숨기고 Tac 대기 local cand = nil local pd = GTV.pendingTac GTV.pendingTac = nil if pd and rid and tonumber(pd.rid) == rid then cand = pd elseif GTV.lastData and rid and tonumber(GTV.lastData.rid) == rid then cand = GTV.lastData end if cand and GTV.on then GTV.lastData = cand GTV.fogKey = nil local ok, err = pcall(GTV.render, cand) if ok then GTV.win:show() else dlog("render 오류: " .. tostring(err)) end else if GTV.win then GTV.win:hide() end GTV.lastData = nil if GTV.on then GTV.requestRefresh("room-without-tac") end end end
-- 타일 다운로드 완료 → 스타일 캐시 비우고 재도색 (Qt가 '깨진 이미지'를 캐시한 칸 복구) function GTV.refreshTiles() for ly, pool in pairs(GTV.P or {}) do for _, l in ipairs(pool) do if l._css and l._css:find("border-image", 1, true) then pcall(function() l:setStyleSheet("background: transparent;") end) end l._css = nil end end if GTV.on and GTV.lastData then GTV.render(GTV.lastData) end end function GTV.dlRefresh() GTV.dlTimer = nil GTV.refreshTiles() end function GTV.onDl(_, path) if type(path) ~= "string" or not path:find("galdamtiles", 1, true) then return end if not (GTV.on and GTV.lastData) then return end -- 114개가 연달아 도착하므로 디바운스 (마지막 도착 후 한 번만 재도색) if GTV.dlTimer then pcall(killTimer, GTV.dlTimer) end GTV.dlTimer = tempTimer(0.7, "GaldamTileView.dlRefresh()") end
function GTV.toggle() GTV.on = not GTV.on if GTV.on then GTV.ensureTiles() echo("[Galdam] 타일뷰 ON — 격자 룸에서 그래픽 타일로 표시 (다시 '타일뷰' 입력=글리프 복귀)\n") local d = (GaldamTac and GaldamTac.lastData) or (gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.Tac) if d then GTV.lastData = d; GTV.fogKey = nil; GTV.render(d); GTV.win:show() if GaldamTac and GaldamTac.win then GaldamTac.win:hide(); GaldamTac.shown = false end else GTV.scheduleBootstrap("toggle-no-data") end else echo("[Galdam] 타일뷰 OFF — 글리프 격자로 복귀\n") if GTV.win then GTV.win:hide() end if GTV.timer then pcall(killTimer, GTV.timer); GTV.timer = nil end if GaldamTac and GaldamTac.lastData and GaldamTac.win then GaldamTac.render(GaldamTac.lastData); GaldamTac.win:show(); GaldamTac.shown = true end end end
if GTV.alias then pcall(killAlias, GTV.alias) end GTV.alias = tempAlias("^타일뷰$", [[GaldamTileView.toggle()]]) if GTV.alias2 then pcall(killAlias, GTV.alias2) end GTV.alias2 = tempAlias("^타일로그$", [[echo("[타일뷰 진단로그]\n") for _, ln in ipairs(GaldamTileView.log or {}) do echo(ln .. "\n") end]]) if GTV.alias3 then pcall(killAlias, GTV.alias3) end GTV.alias3 = tempAlias("^갯담진단$", [[echo("[갯담진단] 퀵메뉴=" .. tostring(GaldamQuick ~= nil) .. " / 패드=" .. tostring(GaldamBoatPad ~= nil) .. " / 해도=" .. tostring(GaldamSeaChart ~= nil) .. " / 이동키=" .. tostring(GaldamKeys ~= nil) .. " / 타일뷰=" .. tostring(GaldamTileView ~= nil) .. "\n")]]) if GTV.h1 then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, GTV.h1) end if GTV.h2 then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, GTV.h2) end if GTV.h3 then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, GTV.h3) end if GTV.h4 then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, GTV.h4) end if GTV.h5 then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, GTV.h5) end if GTV.h6 then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, GTV.h6) end if GTV.h7 then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, GTV.h7) end GTV.h1 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Tac", "GaldamTileView.onTac") GTV.h2 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Room", "GaldamTileView.onRoom") GTV.h3 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", "GaldamTileView.onDl") GTV.h4 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", function() GaldamTileView.scheduleBootstrap("connect") end) GTV.h5 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Char.Vitals", function() if not GaldamTileView.lastData then GaldamTileView.scheduleBootstrap("vitals") end end) GTV.h6 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Status", function() if not GaldamTileView.lastData then GaldamTileView.scheduleBootstrap("status") end end) GTV.h7 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Players", function() if not GaldamTileView.lastData then GaldamTileView.scheduleBootstrap("players") end end) GTV.makeWin() GTV.ensureTiles() GTV.scheduleBootstrap("load") -- 재로드 시 기존 풀 라벨에도 클릭스루 소급 적용 for ly, pool in pairs(GTV.P) do if THRU[ly] then for _, l in ipairs(pool) do pcall(function() l:enableClickthrough() end) end end end echo("[Galdam] 타일뷰 v3.4 로드됨 — 해도(海圖) 모드(승선 시 자동: 바다 차트+헤딩+정박 표시). '타일뷰'=글리프\n")

Script.name: GaldamMoveKeys
Script.script: -- ===== 이동/채팅 모드 격리 (백틱 ` 토글) — 독립 블록 + tempKey ===== -- 블록 분리(gui105)로 Mudlet 재시작에도 이 블록은 로드됨 → tempKey 매로드 재생성으로 충분. -- ⚠️v38/v39 permKey 잔재(GK_*)는 백틱 중복바인딩 유발 → 이름으로 kill+disable 정리. GaldamKeys = GaldamKeys or {} local GK = GaldamKeys GK.on = GK.on or false GK.usePerm = nil -- 구 permKey 잔재 제거(이름) + 비활성화 (둘중 되는걸로) for _, nm in ipairs({"GK_toggle","GK_W","GK_S","GK_A","GK_D","GK_Q","GK_E","GK_Z","GK_C","GK_F","GK_R","GK_N8","GK_N5","GK_N4","GK_N6","GK_N7","GK_N9","GK_N1","GK_N3","GK_N2","GK_N0"}) do pcall(function() killKey(nm) end) pcall(function() disableKey(nm) end) end for _, id in ipairs(GK.permIds or {}) do pcall(killKey, id) end GK.permIds = {} for _, id in ipairs(GK.ids or {}) do pcall(killKey, id) end GK.ids = {} if GK.tid then pcall(killKey, GK.tid); GK.tid = nil end local KP = 0x20000000 -- 이동 디스패처: 퀵메뉴 열림 = W/S 탐색, D/Space 실행, A 닫기. 평시 = 한글 이동명령 send GK.MOV = {N="\235\182\129", S="\235\130\168", W="\236\132\156", E="\235\143\153", NW="\235\182\129\236\132\156", NE="\235\182\129\235\143\153", SW="\235\130\168\236\132\156", SE="\235\130\168\235\143\153", SR="\236\136\152\236\131\137", LK="\235\179\180\234\184\176"} function GK.go(tag) if GaldamQuick and GaldamQuick.open then if tag == "N" then GaldamQuick.nav(-1) elseif tag == "S" then GaldamQuick.nav(1) elseif tag == "E" then GaldamQuick.exec() elseif tag == "W" then GaldamQuick.close() end return end -- 손전등 빔 방향 추적 (이동 방향 기억 → 타일뷰 삼지창 빔) local DV = {N={0,-1}, S={0,1}, W={-1,0}, E={1,0}, NW={-1,-1}, NE={1,-1}, SW={-1,1}, SE={1,1}} if DV[tag] then GaldamTileView.faceDir = DV[tag] end send(GK.MOV[tag]) end local function gk(tag) return "GaldamKeys.go(\"" .. tag .. "\")" end local SPC = [[if GaldamQuick then GaldamQuick.toggle() end]] local WASD = {{0x57,gk("N")},{0x53,gk("S")},{0x41,gk("W")},{0x44,gk("E")},{0x51,gk("NW")},{0x45,gk("NE")},{0x5A,gk("SW")},{0x43,gk("SE")},{0x46,gk("SR")},{0x52,gk("LK")},{0x20,SPC},{0x56,SPC}} local NUM = {{0x38,gk("N")},{0x35,gk("S")},{0x34,gk("W")},{0x36,gk("E")},{0x37,gk("NW")},{0x39,gk("NE")},{0x31,gk("SW")},{0x33,gk("SE")},{0x32,gk("LK")},{0x30,gk("SR")}} function GK.unbind() for _, id in ipairs(GK.ids) do pcall(killKey, id) end GK.ids = {} end function GK.bind() GK.unbind() for _, kv in ipairs(WASD) do local ok, id = pcall(tempKey, kv[1], kv[2]); if ok and id then GK.ids[#GK.ids+1]=id end end for _, kv in ipairs(NUM) do local o1,i1 = pcall(tempKey, KP, kv[1], kv[2]) if o1 and i1 then GK.ids[#GK.ids+1]=i1 else local o2,i2 = pcall(tempKey, kv[1], KP, kv[2]); if o2 and i2 then GK.ids[#GK.ids+1]=i2 end end end end function GK.placeIndicator() if not GK.ind then return end local ok, w, h = pcall(getMainWindowSize) if not ok or not tonumber(w) or not tonumber(h) then pcall(function() GK.ind:move("34%", "-154") GK.ind:resize(430, 26) end) return end local iw = math.min(430, math.max(320, math.floor(w * 0.34))) local x = math.floor((w - iw) / 2) local bottom = (GaldamUI and GaldamUI.BOTTOM_H) or 120 local y = math.max(8, h - bottom - 34) GK.ind:move(x, y) GK.ind:resize(iw, 26) end function GK.setMode(on) GK.on = on if on then GK.bind() else GK.unbind() end pcall(function() GK.ind = GK.ind or GKInd if not GK.ind then GK.ind = Geyser.Label:new({name="GKInd", x="34%", y="-154", width=430, height=26}) end local fg = on and "#9fe8b0" or "#c8a05a" GK.ind:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(16,28,40,236); border:1px solid #5a8ac8; border-radius:5px; color:" .. fg .. "; font-size:12px; padding-top:4px; qproperty-alignment:'AlignCenter';") GK.placeIndicator() GK.ind:echo(on and "● 이동모드: WASD/QEZC 이동 (콘솔키=채팅)" or "○ 채팅모드 (콘솔키=이동)") GK.ind:show() end) end function GK.toggle() GK.setMode(not GK.on) end function GK.bindToggle() if GK.tid then pcall(killKey, GK.tid); GK.tid = nil end local okt, tid = pcall(tempKey, 0x60, [[GaldamKeys.toggle()]]) if okt and tid then GK.tid = tid end end GK.bindToggle() GK.setMode(GK.on) -- 세션 중 패치 재설치 대비 안전망 function GK.reinit() GK.bindToggle(); GK.setMode(GK.on) end if GK.h_conn then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, GK.h_conn) end if GK.h_vit then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, GK.h_vit); GK.h_vit = nil end GK.h_conn = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", function() pcall(function() GaldamKeys.reinit() end) pcall(function() tempTimer(2.5, function() GaldamKeys.reinit() end) end) end) echo("[Galdam] 이동/채팅 모드 격리 로드 (독립블록/tempKey) — 콘솔키(`) 토글\n")

Script.name: GaldamQuickMenu
Script.script: -- ===== 스페이스바 퀵 메뉴 (Arma식 상호작용 리스트) ===== -- 이동모드에서 Space → 서버 _galdamquick → 인접 객체 명령 GMCP → 리스트 메뉴. -- W/S·↑↓ 탐색, D/Space/Enter 실행, A/Esc/취소 닫기, 마우스 클릭도 가능. GaldamQuick = GaldamQuick or {} local GQ = GaldamQuick GQ.open = GQ.open or false GQ.items = GQ.items or {} GQ.sel = 1 GQ.kids = GQ.kids or {} local MN = "GaldamQuickWin" function GQ.win() if GQ.w then return GQ.w end GQ.w = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({name=MN, x="36%", y="26%", width=300, height=200}) GQ.w:setColor(13,19,27) pcall(function() GQ.w:setFontSize(11) end) GQ.w:setWrap(70) return GQ.w end function GQ.render() local w = GQ.win() local h = (#GQ.items + 2) * 19 + 14 pcall(function() w:resize(306, h) end) pcall(function() clearWindow(MN) end) pcall(function() cecho(MN, " \226\154\161 \236\131\129\237\152\184\236\158\145\236\154\169") cecho(MN, " <#8890a4>W/S \237\131\144\236\131\137 \194\183 Space \236\139\164\237\150\137 \194\183 A \235\139\171\234\184\176\n") end) for i, it in ipairs(GQ.items) do local sel = (i == GQ.sel) local mark = sel and "\226\150\182 " or " " local label if it.cancel then label = it.l or "\226\156\150 \236\183\168\236\134\140" else label = (it.o or "?") .. " \194\183 " .. (it.l or "?") .. ((it.k == "arg") and " (\236\158\133\235\160\165)" or "") end local lua = "GaldamQuick.pick(" .. i .. ")" pcall(function() if sel then setFgColor(MN, 255, 224, 120) elseif it.cancel then setFgColor(MN, 220, 130, 120) else setFgColor(MN, 150, 216, 160) end echoLink(MN, mark .. label, lua, label, true) echo(MN, "\n") end) end pcall(function() w:show(); raiseWindow(MN) end) end function GQ.bindNavKeys() GQ.unbindNavKeys() local keys = { {0x01000013, [[GaldamQuick.nav(-1)]]}, {0x01000015, [[GaldamQuick.nav(1)]]}, {0x01000004, [[GaldamQuick.exec()]]}, {0x01000005, [[GaldamQuick.exec()]]}, {0x01000000, [[GaldamQuick.close()]]}, } for _, kv in ipairs(keys) do local ok, id = pcall(tempKey, kv[1], kv[2]) if ok and id then GQ.kids[#GQ.kids+1] = id end end end function GQ.unbindNavKeys() for _, id in ipairs(GQ.kids or {}) do pcall(killKey, id) end GQ.kids = {} end function GQ.show(items) GQ.items = items or {} GQ.items[#GQ.items+1] = {cancel=true} GQ.sel = 1 GQ.open = true GQ.bindNavKeys() GQ.render() end function GQ.close() GQ.open = false GQ.unbindNavKeys() pcall(function() if GQ.w then GQ.w:hide() end end) end function GQ.nav(d) if not GQ.open then return end GQ.sel = GQ.sel + d if GQ.sel < 1 then GQ.sel = #GQ.items end if GQ.sel > #GQ.items then GQ.sel = 1 end GQ.render() end function GQ.pick(i) GQ.sel = i GQ.exec() end function GQ.exec() if not GQ.open then return end local it = GQ.items[GQ.sel] GQ.close() if (not it) or it.cancel then return end if GaldamUI and GaldamUI.menuPick then GaldamUI.menuPick(it.c or "", it.k == "arg") elseif it.c and it.c ~= "" then send(it.c) end end function GQ.toggle() if GQ.open then GQ.exec() else send("_galdamquick", false) end end function GQ.onQuick() local d = gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.Quick if not d then return end local items = {} for _, it in ipairs(d.items or {}) do items[#items+1] = it end if #items == 0 then items[#items+1] = {o="", l="\236\163\188\235\179\128\236\151\144 \236\131\129\237\152\184\236\158\145\236\154\169\237\149\160 \234\178\131\236\157\180 \236\151\134\235\139\164", cancel=true} end GQ.show(items) end if GQ.h then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, GQ.h) end GQ.h = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Quick", function() pcall(function() GaldamQuick.onQuick() end) end) -- 채팅모드용 alias if GQ.al then pcall(killAlias, GQ.al) end pcall(function() GQ.al = tempAlias("^\237\128\181\235\169\148\235\137\180$", [[send("_galdamquick", false)]]) end) echo("[Galdam] \237\128\181 \235\169\148\235\137\180 \235\161\156\235\147\156 \226\128\148 \236\157\180\235\143\153\235\170\168\235\147\156 Space\n")

Script.name: GaldamSeaChart
Script.script: -- ===== 갯담 해도(海圖) 미니창: 승선 시 자동 표시 (Galdam.Sea, 룸=1타일 13×13) ===== GaldamSeaChart = GaldamSeaChart or {} local GS = GaldamSeaChart GS.frame = GS.frame or 0 local CS = 20 local N = 13 local PX, PY = 8, 24 local TONETINT = {[1]="rgba(18,22,62,85)", [4]="rgba(120,55,15,55)", [5]="rgba(110,40,15,90)", [6]="rgba(5,8,28,140)"} local SEATILE = {L = "weed", S = "dirt2", P = "breakwater", H = "lighthouse"} local function imgcss(f) return (GaldamTileView and GaldamTileView.imgcss) and GaldamTileView.imgcss(f) or "background-color: rgba(30,60,110,255);" end function GS.makeWin() if GS.win then return end GS.win = Geyser.UserWindow:new({name = "갯담해도", width = N * CS + PX * 2, height = N * CS + PY + 10, x = 16, y = 70}) GS.bg = Geyser.Label:new({name = "GSbg", x = 0, y = 0, width = "100%", height = "100%"}, GS.win) GS.bg:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(8,10,16,255);") GS.hdr = Geyser.Label:new({name = "GShdr", x = 6, y = 2, width = N * CS + 4, height = 20}, GS.win) GS.hdr:setStyleSheet("background: transparent;") GS.P = GS.P or {} pcall(function() GS.win:hide() end) end local function lbl(layer, i) GS.P[layer] = GS.P[layer] or {} local t = GS.P[layer] if not t[i] then t[i] = Geyser.Label:new({name = "GS_" .. layer .. "_" .. i, x = 0, y = 0, width = 8, height = 8}, GS.win) t[i]._css = nil; t[i]._geo = nil if layer ~= "ground" then pcall(function() t[i]:enableClickthrough() end) end end return t[i] end local function sty(l, css) if l._css ~= css then l._css = css; l:setStyleSheet(css) end end local function geo(l, x, y, w2, h2) local g = x .. "," .. y .. "," .. w2 .. "," .. h2 if l._geo ~= g then l._geo = g; l:move(x, y); l:resize(w2, h2) end l:show() end local function hideRest(layer, n) local t = GS.P[layer] or {} for i = n + 1, #t do t[i]:hide() end end function GS.render(d) if not d then return end GS.makeWin() if GaldamTileView and GaldamTileView.ensureTiles then pcall(GaldamTileView.ensureTiles, CS) end local w = tonumber(d.w) or N local h = tonumber(d.h) or N local tone = tonumber(d.tone) or 3 local weather = d.weather or "clear" local tnames = {"새벽", "아침", "낮", "저녁", "노을", "밤"} local spd = tonumber(d.spd) or 0 GS.hdr:echo("⚓ " .. (d.name or "바다") .. " (" .. tostring(d.cx) .. "," .. tostring(d.cy) .. ") " .. (tnames[tone] or "") .. " " .. ((tonumber(d.docked) or 0) == 1 and "정박중" or (tostring(math.floor(spd * 0.6)) .. "kt")) .. " ⛽" .. tostring(d.fuel or 0) .. "") GS.A = {water = {}, wxl = nil, wxt = nil} local gi, di = 0, 0 for y = 0, h - 1 do local row = (d.rows and d.rows[y + 1]) or "" for x = 0, w - 1 do local code = row:sub(x + 1, x + 1) if code == "" then code = "." end gi = gi + 1 local l = lbl("ground", gi) local t = SEATILE[code] if t then sty(l, imgcss(t)) else sty(l, imgcss("water_" .. (GS.frame % 2))) table.insert(GS.A.water, l) end geo(l, PX + x * CS, PY + y * CS, CS, CS) if code == "W" or code == "." then di = di + 1 local dl = lbl("decal", di) sty(dl, "background-color: rgba(6,14,44,95); border: 0;") geo(dl, PX + x * CS, PY + y * CS, CS, CS) end end end hideRest("ground", gi); hideRest("decal", di) -- 실제 탑승 배의 서버 해도 중심. 정적 장식 배를 생성하지 않는다. local c0 = math.floor(w / 2) local bl = lbl("boat", 1) pcall(function() bl:echo("") end) sty(bl, imgcss("boat")) geo(bl, PX + c0 * CS, PY + c0 * CS, CS, CS) -- 헤딩 화살표 (정박 중엔 숨김) local fdi = 0 if (tonumber(d.docked) or 0) ~= 1 then local DIRN = {"n", "ne", "e", "se", "s", "sw", "w", "nw"} local OFFS = {n = {0, -1}, ne = {1, -1}, e = {1, 0}, se = {1, 1}, s = {0, 1}, sw = {-1, 1}, w = {-1, 0}, nw = {-1, -1}} local dn = DIRN[math.floor(((tonumber(d.hd) or 0) + 22) % 360 / 45) + 1] local o = OFFS[dn] local sz = math.max(10, math.floor(CS * 0.6)) fdi = 1 local fl = lbl("arrow", 1) sty(fl, imgcss("arr_" .. dn)) geo(fl, PX + c0 * CS + math.floor(CS / 2 - sz / 2 + o[1] * CS * 0.7), PY + c0 * CS + math.floor(CS / 2 - sz / 2 + o[2] * CS * 0.7), sz, sz) end hideRest("arrow", fdi) -- 시간대 틴트 + 날씨 입자 local tl = lbl("tint", 1) local tcss = TONETINT[tone] if weather == "fog" then tcss = "rgba(165,168,174,120)" elseif weather == "storm" then tcss = "rgba(28,38,66,110)" end if tcss then sty(tl, "background-color: " .. tcss .. "; border: 0;"); geo(tl, PX, PY, w * CS, h * CS) else tl:hide() end local wl = lbl("wx", 1) if weather == "rain" or weather == "snow" or weather == "storm" then local wt = (weather == "snow") and "snow" or "rain" sty(wl, imgcss(wt .. "_" .. (GS.frame % 3))); geo(wl, PX, PY, w * CS, h * CS) GS.A.wxl = wl; GS.A.wxt = wt else wl:hide() end end function GS.tick() GS.timer = nil if not (GS.win and GS.aboard) then return end GS.frame = GS.frame + 1 local A = GS.A or {} if A.wxl and A.wxt then local c = imgcss(A.wxt .. "_" .. (GS.frame % 3)); A.wxl._css = c; A.wxl:setStyleSheet(c) end for _, l in ipairs(A.water or {}) do local c = imgcss("water_" .. (GS.frame % 2)); l._css = c; l:setStyleSheet(c) end GS.timer = tempTimer(0.5, "GaldamSeaChart.tick()") end function GS.onSea() local d = gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.Sea if not d then return end GS.lastSea = d GS.aboard = true local ok = pcall(GS.render, d) if ok then pcall(function() GS.win:show() end) end if not GS.timer then GS.timer = tempTimer(0.5, "GaldamSeaChart.tick()") end end function GS.onRoom() local rids = gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.Room and gmcp.Galdam.Room.roomid local rid = rids and tonumber((tostring(rids):gsub("#", ""))) or nil if rid ~= GS.curRoom then GS.curRoom = rid GS.aboard = false if GS.win then pcall(function() GS.win:hide() end) end if GaldamBoatPad and GaldamBoatPad.hide then pcall(GaldamBoatPad.hide) end end end if GS.h1 then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, GS.h1) end if GS.h2 then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, GS.h2) end GS.h1 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Sea", "GaldamSeaChart.onSea") GS.h2 = registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Galdam.Room", "GaldamSeaChart.onRoom") GS.makeWin() echo("[Galdam] 해도 미니창 로드됨 (승선 시 자동)\n")

Script.name: GaldamBoatPad
Script.script:
-- ===== 갯담 배 조종패드: 조타륜 인접 시 격자창 바로 아래 표시 (가로형) ===== GaldamBoatPad = GaldamBoatPad or {} local GB = GaldamBoatPad local BTN = "background-color: rgba(24,34,52,235); border:1px solid #4a6a96; border-radius:7px; color:#cfe4ff; qproperty-alignment:'AlignCenter'; font-size:13px;" local BTN2 = "background-color: rgba(40,32,18,235); border:1px solid #96804a; border-radius:7px; color:#ffe9c0; qproperty-alignment:'AlignCenter'; font-size:13px;" local BTN3 = "background-color: rgba(18,40,28,235); border:1px solid #4a9668; border-radius:7px; color:#d2ffe4; qproperty-alignment:'AlignCenter'; font-size:13px;" function GB.make() if GB.win then return end GB.win = Geyser.Label:new({name = "갯담조타패드", x = 300, y = 500, width = 366, height = 176}) GB.win:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgba(10,12,18,242); border: 2px solid #5a8ac8; border-radius: 8px;") local function btn(nm, txt, cmd, x, y, w, h, css) local b = Geyser.Label:new({name = "GB_" .. nm, x = x, y = y, width = w, height = h}, GB.win) b:setStyleSheet(css or BTN) b:echo("
" .. txt .. "
") b:setClickCallback(function() send(cmd) end) return b end local D = {"↖", "↑", "↗", "←", nil, "→", "↙", "↓", "↘"} local KD = {"북서", "북", "북동", "서", nil, "동", "남서", "남", "남동"} local i = 0 for ry = 0, 2 do for rx = 0, 2 do i = i + 1 if D[i] then btn("st" .. i, D[i] .. "
" .. KD[i] .. "", "조타 " .. KD[i], 6 + rx * 56, 6 + ry * 56, 52, 52) else btn("stop", "■

GaldamAtlas=GaldamAtlas or {} local A=GaldamAtlas if A.handlers then for _,id in ipairs(A.handlers) do pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler,id) end end if A.alias then pcall(killAlias,A.alias) end if A.nodes then for _,n in pairs(A.nodes) do pcall(function()n:hide()end) end end if A.root then A.root:hide() end A.handlers={};A.nodes={};A.active=false;A.view=A.view or 'village';A.filter='all';A.page=0 local DATA={["views"]={},["pins"]={},["positions"]={},["images"]={["pharmacy"]="",["harbor"]="",["farm"]="",["food"]="",["post"]="",["fish"]="",["medical"]="",["bank"]="",["warehouse"]="",["shop"]="",["home"]="",["tree"]="",["civic"]="",["police"]="",["lodge"]=""},["palette"]={["medical"]="#d87d76",["pharmacy"]="#8fba86",["police"]="#7badd0",["bank"]="#d2b47d",["post"]="#d69778",["shop"]="#83b3ac",["home"]="#cfb996",["civic"]="#99a3ce",["fish"]="#77babe",["lodge"]="#c8af8e",["food"]="#d69b7c",["warehouse"]="#9daebc",["farm"]="#a4bd80",["harbor"]="#81b8d1",["tree"]="#89b195"}} A.data=DATA;A.ready=false;A.pending=nil;A.syncText='서버 지도를 불러오는 중' local dir=getMudletHomeDir()..'/galdam-atlas-v2' pcall(function() lfs.mkdir(dir) end) for name,bytes in pairs(DATA.images) do local f=io.open(dir..'/'..name..'.png','wb');if f then f:write(GaldamTileView.decodeArchitecturePNG(bytes));f:close() end end -- Geometry is regenerated from an atomic server snapshot, never a bundled map. local ROAD={road=true,village=true,village_lane=true,harbor=true,quay=true,bridge=true,yard=true,parking=true,farm=true,headland=true} local COLORS={forest='url(#land)',sea='url(#sea)',lake='#65989e',stream='#81aeaa',stream_under_bridge='#81aeaa',beach='#d7cba9',tidal='#acbdb1',headland='#a5b79b'} local function num(v)return type(v)=='number' and v==v and math.abs(v)<1000000 end local function regionLabel(r)return ({town='읍내 · 생활시설',village='주택가 · 포구'})[r] or r end local function makeView(label,bounds,index) local span=math.max(bounds[3]-bounds[1]+1,bounds[4]-bounds[2]+1) return {label=label,bounds=bounds,span=span,offset={(span-(bounds[3]-bounds[1]+1))/2,(span-(bounds[4]-bounds[2]+1))/2},fileIndex=index} end local function bounds(points,pad) local b={math.huge,math.huge,-math.huge,-math.huge} for _,p in ipairs(points)do b[1]=math.min(b[1],p[1]);b[2]=math.min(b[2],p[2]);b[3]=math.max(b[3],p[1]);b[4]=math.max(b[4],p[2])end if #points==0 then return {-1,-1,1,1}end return {math.floor(b[1]-pad),math.floor(b[2]-pad),math.ceil(b[3]+pad),math.ceil(b[4]+pad)} end function A.modelFromRows(rows) local m={views={},pins={},positions={},rows={},surface={},byId={},palette=DATA.palette,images=DATA.images,centers={}};local points={};local regions={} for _,r in ipairs(rows)do if type(r)=='table' and num(r[1]) and num(r[2]) and num(r[3]) and type(r[6])=='string' then local id=tostring(math.floor(r[1]));m.byId[id]=r;m.rows[#m.rows+1]=r if r[4]==1 then m.surface[id]=r;points[#points+1]={r[2],r[3]};m.positions[id]={r[2],r[3],r[6]}end end end -- Interior positions follow live exits, so moving a building moves its floors too. for pass=1,16 do local changed=false for id,r in pairs(m.byId)do if not m.positions[id] then for _,target in ipairs(r[8] or {})do local p=m.positions[tostring(target)];if p then m.positions[id]={p[1],p[2],r[6]};changed=true;break end end end end if not changed then break end end for id,r in pairs(m.byId)do if not m.positions[id] and type(r[9])=='table' and num(r[9][1]) and num(r[9][2]) then m.positions[id]={r[9][1],r[9][2],r[6]}end end for _,r in ipairs(m.rows)do if r[4]==1 then for fi,f in ipairs(r[7] or {})do local kind=DATA.palette[f[1]] and f[1] or 'shop';local reg=f[4] or r[10] or 'auto' if reg=='' then reg='auto'end local p={id=tostring(r[1]),key=tostring(r[1])..':'..kind..':'..fi,x=r[2],y=r[3],kind=kind,label=f[2] or r[6],full=f[3] or r[6],view=reg} m.pins[#m.pins+1]=p if reg~='auto' and reg~='all' then regions[reg]=regions[reg] or {};regions[reg][#regions[reg]+1]={r[2],r[3]}end end local reg=r[10];if reg and reg~='' and reg~='all' and reg~='auto' then regions[reg]=regions[reg] or {};regions[reg][#regions[reg]+1]={r[2],r[3]}end end end for reg,pts in pairs(regions)do local x,y=0,0;for _,p in ipairs(pts)do x=x+p[1];y=y+p[2]end;m.centers[reg]={x/#pts,y/#pts}end for _,pin in ipairs(m.pins)do if pin.view=='auto' then local best,dist=nil,math.huge for reg,c in pairs(m.centers)do local d=(pin.x-c[1])^2+(pin.y-c[2])^2;if d<dist then best,dist=reg,d end end pin.view=best or 'village';regions[pin.view]=regions[pin.view] or {};regions[pin.view][#regions[pin.view]+1]={pin.x,pin.y} end end local rank={medical=1,pharmacy=1,police=2,bank=2,post=2,civic=2,shop=3,food=3,fish=3,lodge=3,warehouse=3,home=4,farm=5,tree=5,harbor=5} table.sort(m.pins,function(a,b)local aa,bb=rank[a.kind] or 9,rank[b.kind] or 9;if aa~=bb then return aa<bb end;if a.full~=b.full then return a.full<b.full end;return a.key<b.key end) m.views.all=makeView('갯담 전역',bounds(points,1),1);m.viewOrder={'all'} local extra={};for reg in pairs(regions)do if reg~='town' and reg~='village' then extra[#extra+1]=reg end end;table.sort(extra) local order={'town','village'};for _,reg in ipairs(extra)do order[#order+1]=reg end for _,reg in ipairs(order)do if regions[reg] then m.viewOrder[#m.viewOrder+1]=reg;m.views[reg]=makeView(regionLabel(reg),bounds(regions[reg],3),#m.viewOrder)end end return m end function A.svgFor(m,view) local v=m.views[view];local b=v.bounds;local N=1400;local unit=N/v.span local function xy(x,y)return (x-b[1]+v.offset[1]+.5)*unit,(y-b[2]+v.offset[2]+.5)*unit end local out={'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1400" height="1400" viewBox="0 0 1400 1400"><defs><linearGradient id="sea" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1400"><stop stop-color="#548c94"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#2c6173"/></linearGradient><linearGradient id="land" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1400" y2="1400"><stop stop-color="#9bb49b"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#86a393"/></linearGradient></defs><rect width="1400" height="1400" fill="#203842"/>'};local visible={};local grid={} local function add(s)out[#out+1]=s end for id,r in pairs(m.surface)do grid[r[2]..','..r[3]]=r;local x,y=xy(r[2],r[3]);if x>=-unit and y>=-unit and x<=N+unit and y<=N+unit then visible[#visible+1]=r;local color=COLORS[r[5]] or (ROAD[r[5]] and '#b2c2a5' or '#a9bba2') add(string.format('<rect x="%.2f" y="%.2f" width="%.2f" height="%.2f" fill="%s" shape-rendering="crispEdges"/>',x-unit/2,y-unit/2,unit+1.2,unit+1.2,color)) end end for _,r in ipairs(visible)do local x,y=xy(r[2],r[3]);local scene=r[5];local seed=(r[2]*73856093+r[3]*19349663)%997 if scene=='forest' and seed%11==0 then for _,d in ipairs({{-.13,.05,.075},{.05,-.06,.095},{.2,.12,.065}})do add(string.format('<circle cx="%.2f" cy="%.2f" r="%.2f" fill="#46775a" opacity=".35"/>',x+unit*d[1],y+unit*d[2],math.max(1.5,unit*d[3])))end elseif scene=='sea' then for _,d in ipairs({{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}})do local q=grid[(r[2]+d[1])..','..(r[3]+d[2])];if q and q[5]~='sea' and q[5]~='stream' then if d[1]~=0 then add(string.format('<rect x="%.2f" y="%.2f" width="%.2f" height="%.2f" fill="#9bc6b7" opacity=".30"/>',x+unit*(d[1]<0 and -.5 or .3),y-unit/2,unit*.2,unit+.5)) else add(string.format('<rect x="%.2f" y="%.2f" width="%.2f" height="%.2f" fill="#9bc6b7" opacity=".30"/>',x-unit/2,y+unit*(d[2]<0 and -.5 or .3),unit+.5,unit*.2))end end end if seed%17==0 then add(string.format('<path d="M %.2f %.2f q 6 3 12 0" fill="none" stroke="#accfc8" stroke-opacity=".24"/>',x-6,y))end end end local links={};local drawn={} for _,r in ipairs(visible)do if ROAD[r[5]] then for _,target in ipairs(r[8] or {})do local q=m.surface[tostring(target)];local pair=math.min(r[1],target)..':'..math.max(r[1],target);if q and ROAD[q[5]] and not drawn[pair] then drawn[pair]=true local x,y=xy(r[2],r[3]);local xx,yy=xy(q[2],q[3]);links[#links+1]={x,y,xx,yy,math.max(3,unit*(r[5]=='road' and .18 or .135))} end end end end for _,l in ipairs(links)do add(string.format('<path d="M %.2f %.2f L %.2f %.2f" fill="none" stroke="#859684" stroke-width="%.2f" stroke-linecap="round"/>',l[1],l[2],l[3],l[4],l[5]+3))end for _,l in ipairs(links)do add(string.format('<path d="M %.2f %.2f L %.2f %.2f" fill="none" stroke="#f0ead3" stroke-width="%.2f" stroke-linecap="round"/>',l[1],l[2],l[3],l[4],l[5]))end add('</svg>');return table.concat(out) end function A.acceptSnapshot(rows,revision) local m=A.modelFromRows(rows);local files={};local serial=(A.svgSerial or 0)+1 local ok=pcall(function()for key,v in pairs(m.views)do local path=dir..'/map-'..serial..'-'..v.fileIndex..'.svg';local f=assert(io.open(path,'wb'));f:write(A.svgFor(m,key));f:close();files[key]=path end end) if not ok then for _,path in pairs(files)do pcall(os.remove,path)end;A.syncText='지도 생성 실패 · 다시 열어 주세요';return false end local selected=A.selected and DATA.pins[A.selected] and DATA.pins[A.selected].key local previous=A.mapFiles or {};DATA=m;A.data=m;A.mapFiles=files;A.svgSerial=serial;A.revision=revision;A.ready=true;A.syncText='서버 지도 · 최신 상태';A.selected=nil for i,p in ipairs(m.pins)do if p.key==selected then A.selected=i;break end end if not m.views[A.view]then A.view=m.views.village and 'village' or 'all'end for _,path in pairs(previous)do pcall(os.remove,path)end if A.active then A.render()end return true end function A.receiveWorld(d) if type(d)~='table' then return end if d.mode=='begin' and type(d.revision)=='string' and num(d.total) then A.pending={revision=d.revision,total=d.total,rows={},seen={},at=os.time()};A.syncText='마을 지도 갱신 중' elseif d.mode=='chunk' and A.pending and d.revision==A.pending.revision then for _,r in ipairs(d.rows or {})do if type(r)=='table' and num(r[1]) and not A.pending.seen[r[1]]then A.pending.seen[r[1]]=true;A.pending.rows[#A.pending.rows+1]=r end end elseif d.mode=='end' and A.pending and d.revision==A.pending.revision then local p=A.pending;A.pending=nil;if #p.rows==p.total then A.acceptSnapshot(p.rows,p.revision)else A.syncText='지도 수신 대기 · 다시 열어 주세요'end elseif d.mode=='unchanged' then A.syncText='서버 지도 · 최신 상태' elseif d.mode=='error' then A.pending=nil;A.syncText='지도 갱신 지연 · 잠시 후 다시 확인합니다';if A.active then A.render()end end end function A.requestWorld(force) if type(send)=='function' then A.syncText='서버 지도 확인 중';send(force and 'map' or 'atlasrefresh',false)end end if A.timer then pcall(killTimer,A.timer)end local function refreshLater() A.timer=tempTimer(15,function() if A.active and (not A.pending or os.time()-A.pending.at>35)then A.requestWorld(not A.ready)end refreshLater() end) end if type(tempTimer)=='function' then refreshLater()end A.handlers[#A.handlers+1]=registerAnonymousEventHandler('gmcp.Galdam.AtlasData',function()A.receiveWorld(gmcp.Galdam and gmcp.Galdam.AtlasData)end)

n:setClickCallback(click) end n:show();pcall(function()n:raise()end);return n end local function group(k) if k=='home' then return 'home' end if k=='medical' or k=='pharmacy' then return 'medical' end
